21.8.s: trivṛt prātassavanaṃ pañcadaśaṃ mādhyandinaṃ savanaṃ saptadaśaṃ tṛtīyasavanaṃ ekaviṃśaṃ prātassavanaṃ triṇavaṃ mādhyandinaṃ savanaṃ trayastriṃśaṃ tṛtīyasavanaṃ sokthaṃ caturviṃśaṃ prātassavanaṃ catuścatvāriṃśaṃ mādhyandinaṃ savanam aṣṭācatvāriṃśaṃ tṛtīyasavanaṃ soktham ekaviṃśaḥ ṣoḍaśī pañcadaśī rātris trivṛt sandhiḥ parākaḥ
21.8.d: त्रिवृत् प्रातस्सवनं पञ्चदशं माध्यन्दिनं सवनं सप्तदशं तृतीयसवनं एकविंशं प्रातस्सवनं त्रिणवं माध्यन्दिनं सवनं त्रयस्त्रिंशं तृतीयसवनं सोक्थं चतुर्विंशं प्रातस्सवनं चतुश्चत्वारिंशं माध्यन्दिनं सवनम् अष्टाचत्वारिंशं तृतीयसवनं सोक्थम् एकविंशः षोडशी पञ्चदशी रात्रिस् त्रिवृत् सन्धिः पराकः
21.8.m: The morning pressing is ninefold, the midday pressing fifteenfold, the third pressing seventeenfold. [On the second day,] the morning pressing is twenty-one-fold, the midday pressing twenty-seven-fold, the third pressing thirty-three-fold with ukthas. [On the third day,] the morning pressing is twenty-four-fold, the midday pressing forty-four-fold, the third pressing forty-eight-fold with ukthas; the ṣoḍaśin is twenty-one-fold, the night is fifteenfold, the sandhi is ninefold: [this is] the Parāka rite.

21.8.s: parākeṇa vai devāḥ svargaṃ lokamāyan svargakāmo yajeta parāṅ evaitena svargaṃ lokam ākramate
21.8.d: पराकेण वै देवाः स्वर्गं लोकमायन् स्वर्गकामो यजेत पराङ् एवैतेन स्वर्गं लोकम् आक्रमते
21.8.m: By means of the Parāka the gods went to the world of heaven. One who desires heaven should sacrifice [with it]; directly, indeed, does he stride to the world of heaven by this.

21.8.s: yad vā etasyākaṃ tad asya parāk tat parākasya parākatvam
21.8.d: यद् वा एतस्याकं तद् अस्य पराक् तत् पराकस्य पराकत्वम्
21.8.m: Now, what is pain for him, that is departed from him; that is the departedness of the Parāka.
For him who has gone thither, there is no pain whatsoever.

21.8.s: nāsmā akaṃ bhavati ya evaṃ veda
21.8.d: नास्मा अकं भवति य एवं वेद
21.8.m: No pain comes to him who knows thus.

21.8.s: prajāyās tv akḷptaḥ parāṅ hy evaitena svargaṃ lokam ākramate tad yad ekaviṃśaḥ ṣoḍaśī bhavati pañcadaśī rātris trivṛt sandhis tenāsmin loke pratitiṣṭhati
21.8.d: प्रजायास् त्व् अकॢप्तः पराङ् ह्य् एवैतेन स्वर्गं लोकम् आक्रमते तद् यद् एकविंशः षोडशी भवति पञ्चदशी रात्रिस् त्रिवृत् सन्धिस् तेनास्मिन् लोके प्रतितिष्ठति
21.8.m: However, it is unsuited for offspring, for directly does he stride to the world of heaven by this. In that the ṣoḍaśin is twenty-one-fold, the night fifteenfold, and the sandhi ninefold, he thereby stands firmly in this world.

21.9.s: caturviṃśāḥ pavamānās trivṛnty ājyāni pañcadaśāni pṛṣṭhāni saptadaśo 'gniṣṭomaś caturviṃśāḥ pavamānāḥ pañcadaśāny ājyāni saptadaśāni pṛṣṭhāny ekaviṃśo 'gniṣṭomaḥ sokthaś caturviṃśāḥ pavamānāḥ saptadaśāny ājyāny ekaviṃśani pṛṣṭhāni triṇavo 'gniṣṭomaḥ sokthaś caturviṃśāḥ pavamānā ekaviṃśāny ājyāni triṇavāni pṛṣṭhāni trayastriṃśo 'gniṣṭoma ekaviṃśāny ukthāni saṣoḍaśikāni pañcadaśī rātris trivṛt sandhi
21.9.d: चतुर्विंशाः पवमानास् त्रिवृन्त्य् आज्यानि पञ्चदशानि पृष्ठानि सप्तदशो ऽग्निष्टोमश् चतुर्विंशाः पवमानाः पञ्चदशान्य् आज्यानि सप्तदशानि पृष्ठान्य् एकविंशो ऽग्निष्टोमः सोक्थश् चतुर्विंशाः पवमानाः सप्तदशान्य् आज्यान्य् एकविंशनि पृष्ठानि त्रिणवो ऽग्निष्टोमः सोक्थश् चतुर्विंशाः पवमाना एकविंशान्य् आज्यानि त्रिणवानि पृष्ठानि त्रयस्त्रिंशो ऽग्निष्टोम एकविंशान्य् उक्थानि सषोडशिकानि पञ्चदशी रात्रिस् त्रिवृत् सन्धि
21.9.m: The pavamānas are twenty-four-fold, the ājyastotras ninefold, the pṛṣṭhas fifteenfold, the agniṣṭoma seventeenfold. [On the second day,] the pavamānas are twenty-four-fold, the ājyastotras fifteenfold, the pṛṣṭhas seventeenfold, the agniṣṭoma twenty-one-fold with ukthas. [On the third day,] the pavamānas are twenty-four-fold, the ājyastotras seventeenfold, the pṛṣṭhas twenty-one-fold, the agniṣṭoma twenty-seven-fold with ukthas. [On the fourth day,] the pavamānas are twenty-four-fold, the ājyastotras twenty-one-fold, the pṛṣṭhas twenty-seven-fold, the agniṣṭoma thirty-three-fold, the ukthas twenty-one-fold together with the ṣoḍaśin, the night fifteenfold, the sandhi ninefold.

21.9.s: atrir akāmayata catvāro me vīrā ājāyerann iti sa etam apaśyat tasya catvāro vīrā ājāyantāsya catvāro vīrā jāyante ya evaṃ veda
21.9.d: अत्रिर् अकामयत चत्वारो मे वीरा आजायेरन्न् इति स एतम् अपश्यत् तस्य चत्वारो वीरा आजायन्तास्य चत्वारो वीरा जायन्ते य एवं वेद
21.9.m: Atri desired: "May four heroes be born to me!" He saw this [rite]; four heroes were born to him. Four heroes are born to him who knows thus.

21.9.s: ekaṃ stomam utsṛjyaikam abhyārabhate vīrajananaṃ vai stomo vīram evāsmai tat prajanayati
21.9.d: एकं स्तोमम् उत्सृज्यैकम् अभ्यारभते वीरजननं वै स्तोमो वीरम् एवास्मै तत् प्रजनयति
21.9.m: Setting aside one stoma, he takes up another. The stoma is indeed the procreation of a hero; thus he procreates a hero for him.

21.9.s: caturviṃśāḥ pavamānā bhavanti caturviṃśatyakṣarā gāyatrī prajananaṃ gāyatrī prajātyai
21.9.d: चतुर्विंशाः पवमाना भवन्ति चतुर्विंशत्यक्षरा गायत्री प्रजननं गायत्री प्रजात्यै
21.9.m: The pavamānas are twenty-four-fold. The gāyatrī has twenty-four syllables. The gāyatrī is procreation, for propagation.

21.9.s: ubhaye stomā yugmantaś cāyujaś ca tan mithunaṃ tasmān mithunāt prajāyate
21.9.d: उभये स्तोमा युग्मन्तश् चायुजश् च तन् मिथुनं तस्मान् मिथुनात् प्रजायते
21.9.m: Both stomas are [used], the even and the odd. That is a pair; from that pair he propagates.

21.9.s: agniṣṭomaḥ prathamam ahar ūktho dvitīyaṃ ṣoḍaśī tṛtīyam atirātraś caturthaṃ nānāvīryatāyai
21.9.d: अग्निष्टोमः प्रथमम् अहर् ऊक्थो द्वितीयं षोडशी तृतीयम् अतिरात्रश् चतुर्थं नानावीर्यतायै
21.9.m: The first day is an agniṣṭoma, the second an ukthya, the third a ṣoḍaśin, the fourth an atirātra, for the sake of different powers.
He makes the days of different powers.

21.9.s: gāyatraṃ vai prathamam ahas traiṣṭubhaṃ dvitīyaṃ jāgataṃ tṛtīyam ānuṣṭubhaṃ caturtham
21.9.d: गायत्रं वै प्रथमम् अहस् त्रैष्टुभं द्वितीयं जागतं तृतीयम् आनुष्टुभं चतुर्थम्
21.9.m: The first day belongs to the gāyatrī, the second to the triṣṭubh, the third to the jagatī, the fourth to the anuṣṭubh.

21.9.s: tad āhur yat tṛtīye 'hani ṣoḍaśinaṃ gṛhṇīyus tṛtīyenāhnānuṣṭubham āpnuyur acchandaś caturtham ahaḥ syād ānuṣṭubho vai ṣoḍaśīti
21.9.d: तद् आहुर् यत् तृतीये ऽहनि षोडशिनं गृह्णीयुस् तृतीयेनाह्नानुष्टुभम् आप्नुयुर् अच्छन्दश् चतुर्थम् अहः स्याद् आनुष्टुभो वै षोडशीति
21.9.m: Concerning this they say: "If they were to take the ṣoḍaśi-cup on the third day, they would reach the anuṣṭubh on the third day, and the fourth day would be without a metre, for the ṣoḍaśin belongs to the anuṣṭubh."

21.9.s: caturthe 'hani ṣoḍaśī grahītavyaḥ sva āyatane ṣoḍaśī gṛhyate
21.9.d: चतुर्थे ऽहनि षोडशी ग्रहीतव्यः स्व आयतने षोडशी गृह्यते
21.9.m: On the fourth day the ṣoḍaśi-cup is to be taken; the ṣoḍaśin is taken in its own abode.
Through the metres he makes the days of different powers.

21.9.s: naudhasaṃ prathamasyāhno brahmasāma śyaitaṃ dvitīyasya śrāyantīyaṃ tṛtīyasya traiśokaṃ caturthasya
21.9.d: नौधसं प्रथमस्याह्नो ब्रह्मसाम श्यैतं द्वितीयस्य श्रायन्तीयं तृतीयस्य त्रैशोकं चतुर्थस्य
21.9.m: The Naudhasa is the brahmasāman of the first day, the Śyaita of the second, the Śrāyantīya of the third, the Traiśoka of the fourth.

21.9.s: tad āhur apabhraṃśa iva vā eṣa yat jyāyasaḥ chandaso 'dhi kanīyaś chanda upaitīti
21.9.d: तद् आहुर् अपभ्रंश इव वा एष यत् ज्यायसः छन्दसो ऽधि कनीयश् छन्द उपैतीति
21.9.m: Concerning this they say: "It is indeed like a descent when one passes from a greater metre to a smaller metre."
Therefore, this atijagatī is employed on the fourth day, to prevent a descent.

21.9.s: kāleyaṃ prathamasyāho 'cchāvākasāma mādhucchandasaṃ dvitīyasya rauravaṃ tṛtīyasya samantaṃ caturthasya nānāvīryatāyai nānāvīryāṇy ahāni karoti
21.9.d: कालेयं प्रथमस्याहो ऽच्छावाकसाम माधुच्छन्दसं द्वितीयस्य रौरवं तृतीयस्य समन्तं चतुर्थस्य नानावीर्यतायै नानावीर्याण्य् अहानि करोति
21.9.m: The Kāleya is the acchāvākasāman of the first day, the Mādhucchandasa of the second, the Raurava of the third, the Samanta of the fourth, for the sake of different powers; he makes the days of different powers.

21.9.s: abhitvā vṛṣabhā suta iti tṛtīyasyāhno rathantaraṃ kastam indra tvā vasava iti vāmadevyaṃ yajñā yathā apūrva iti caturthasyāhno bṛhat ed u madhor madintaram iti vāmadevyaṃ chandasāṃ nānāvīryatāyai nānāvīryāṇy ahāni kāroti
21.9.d: अभित्वा वृषभा सुत इति तृतीयस्याह्नो रथन्तरं कस्तम् इन्द्र त्वा वसव इति वामदेव्यं यज्ञा यथा अपूर्व इति चतुर्थस्याह्नो बृहत् एद् उ मधोर् मदिन्तरम् इति वामदेव्यं छन्दसां नानावीर्यतायै नानावीर्याण्य् अहानि कारोति
21.9.m: On "To thee, the bull, pressed out" is the Rathantara of the third day; on "Who, O Indra, to thee, the Vasus" is the Vāmadevya. On "O sacrifices, as non-precedented" is the Bṛhat of the fourth day; on "Come, of the mead most exhilarating" is the Vāmadevya; for the sake of different powers of the metres, he makes the days of different powers.

21.10.s: trivṛt pañcadaśo 'gniṣṭomaḥ prathamam ahaḥ
21.10.d: त्रिवृत् पञ्चदशो ऽग्निष्टोमः प्रथमम् अहः
21.10.m: The first day is a ninefold and fifteenfold agniṣṭoma.

21.10.s: athottarasyāhnoś caturviṃśaṃ vahiṣpavamānaṃ pañcadaśāni trīṇy ājyāni saptadaśam acchāvākasyaikaviṃśo mādhyandinaḥ pavamānaḥ saptadaśe dve pṛṣṭhe ekaviṃśaṃ tṛtīyasavanaṃṃ soktham
21.10.d: अथोत्तरस्याह्नोश् चतुर्विंशं वहिष्पवमानं पञ्चदशानि त्रीण्य् आज्यानि सप्तदशम् अच्छावाकस्यैकविंशो माध्यन्दिनः पवमानः सप्तदशे द्वे पृष्ठे एकविंशं तृतीयसवनंं सोक्थम्
21.10.m: Then, for the next day, the Bahiṣpavamāna is twenty-four-fold; three ājyastotras are fifteenfold, [that] of the acchāvāka is seventeenfold; the Mādhyandina Pavamāna is twenty-one-fold; two pṛṣṭhas are seventeenfold; the third pressing is twenty-one-fold, having ukthas.

21.10.s: tṛtīyasyāhna ekaviṃśaṃ bahiṣpavamānaṃ trīṇi cājyāni pañcadaśam acchāvākasya caturviṃśo mādhyandinaḥ pavamāna ekaviṃśāni pṛṣṭhāni triṇavaṃ tṛtīyasavanaṃ dve cokthe ekaviṃśam acchāvākasya
21.10.d: तृतीयस्याह्न एकविंशं बहिष्पवमानं त्रीणि चाज्यानि पञ्चदशम् अच्छावाकस्य चतुर्विंशो माध्यन्दिनः पवमान एकविंशानि पृष्ठानि त्रिणवं तृतीयसवनं द्वे चोक्थे एकविंशम् अच्छावाकस्य
21.10.m: For the third day, the Bahiṣpavamāna is twenty-one-fold, and three ājyastotras [are twenty-one-fold], [that] of the acchāvāka is fifteenfold; the Mādhyandina Pavamāna is twenty-four-fold; the pṛṣṭhas are twenty-one-fold; the third pressing is twenty-seven-fold, and [so are] two ukthas, [while that] of the acchāvāka is twenty-one-fold.

21.10.s: caturthasyāhnaś caturviśāḥ pavamānāḥ pañcadaśaṃ hotur ājyaṃ saptadaśāni trīṇy ekaviṃśāni pṛṣṭhāni trayastriṃśo 'gniṣṭoma ekaviṃśāny ukthāni saṣoḍaśikāni pañcadaśī rātris trivṛt sandhiḥ
21.10.d: चतुर्थस्याह्नश् चतुर्विशाः पवमानाः पञ्चदशं होतुर् आज्यं सप्तदशानि त्रीण्य् एकविंशानि पृष्ठानि त्रयस्त्रिंशो ऽग्निष्टोम एकविंशान्य् उक्थानि सषोडशिकानि पञ्चदशी रात्रिस् त्रिवृत् सन्धिः
21.10.m: For the fourth day, the pavamānas are twenty-four-fold; the hotṛ's ājyastotra is fifteenfold, three [ājyastotras] are seventeenfold; the pṛṣṭhas are twenty-one-fold; the agniṣṭoma [chant] is thirty-three-fold; the ukthas are twenty-one-fold, with a sixteenfold chant; the night is fifteenfold; the twilight chant is ninefold.

21.10.s: jamadagniḥ puṣṭikāma etam āharat sa imān poṣān apuṣyat
21.10.d: जमदग्निः पुष्टिकाम एतम् आहरत् स इमान् पोषान् अपुष्यत्
21.10.m: Jamadagni, desirous of prosperity, brought this [rite]. He prospered with these prosperities.

21.10.s: yad idam āhur navā ūrvau palitau sañjānāte iti
21.10.d: यद् इदम् आहुर् नवा ऊर्वौ पलितौ सञ्जानाते इति
21.10.m: As to what they say here: 'Two new grey thighs agree with one another'—

21.10.s: tat sarvān evaitena poṣān puṣyati
21.10.d: तत् सर्वान् एवैतेन पोषान् पुष्यति
21.10.m: thus he prospers with all prosperities by this [rite].

21.10.s: jagatī chandobhiḥ sampadyate
21.10.d: जगती छन्दोभिः सम्पद्यते
21.10.m: It corresponds to the jagatī through the metres.

21.10.s: jagatī vai chandasāṃ paramaṃ poṣaṃ puṣṭā paramam evaite poṣaṃ puṣyati
21.10.d: जगती वै छन्दसां परमं पोषं पुष्टा परमम् एवैते पोषं पुष्यति
21.10.m: The jagatī, indeed, among the metres has prospered with supreme prosperity; he indeed prospers with supreme prosperity by this [rite].

21.10.s: puroḍāśinya upasado bhavanti paśavo vai puroḍāśāḥ paśuṣveva pratitiṣṭhanti
21.10.d: पुरोडाशिन्य उपसदो भवन्ति पशवो वै पुरोडाशाः पशुष्वेव प्रतितिष्ठन्ति
21.10.m: The upasads have sacrificial cakes. The sacrificial cakes are indeed cattle; they firmly establish themselves in cattle.

21.10.s: agne ver hotra ver adhvaram āpitaraṃ vaiśvānaram avase 'kar indrāya devebhyo juhutā haviḥ svāhā
21.10.d: अग्ने वेर् होत्र वेर् अध्वरम् आपितरं वैश्वानरम् अवसे ऽकर् इन्द्राय देवेभ्यो जुहुता हविः स्वाहा
21.10.m: 'O Agni, accept the hotṛ's office, accept the sacrifice; you have made Vaiśvānara an ally for aid; for Indra, for the gods, sacrifice the oblation, svāhā!'

21.10.s: devāv aśvinau madhukaśayādyemaṃ yajñaṃ yajamānāya mimikṣatam indrāya devebhyo juhutā haviḥ svāhā
21.10.d: देवाव् अश्विनौ मधुकशयाद्येमं यज्ञं यजमानाय मिमिक्षतम् इन्द्राय देवेभ्यो जुहुता हविः स्वाहा
21.10.m: 'O divine Aśvins, sprinkle today this sacrifice for the sacrificer with your honey-whip; for Indra, for the gods, sacrifice the oblation, svāhā!'

21.10.s: deva viṣṇa urv adyāsmin yajñe yajamānāyādhi vikramasvendrāya devebhyo juhutā haviḥ svāhā
21.10.d: देव विष्ण उर्व् अद्यास्मिन् यज्ञे यजमानायाधि विक्रमस्वेन्द्राय देवेभ्यो जुहुता हविः स्वाहा
21.10.m: 'O divine Viṣṇu, stride widely today in this sacrifice for the sacrificer; for Indra, for the gods, sacrifice the oblation, svāhā!'

21.10.s: deva soma retodhā adyāsmin yajñe yajamānāyaidhīndrāya devebhyo juhutā haviḥ svāhā
21.10.d: देव सोम रेतोधा अद्यास्मिन् यज्ञे यजमानायैधीन्द्राय देवेभ्यो जुहुता हविः स्वाहा
21.10.m: 'O divine Soma, be the placer of seed today in this sacrifice for the sacrificer; for Indra, for the gods, sacrifice the oblation, svāhā!'

21.10.s: deva savitaḥ susāvitram adyāsmin yajñe yajamānāsuvasvendrāya devebhyo juhutā haviḥ svāhā
21.10.d: देव सवितः सुसावित्रम् अद्यास्मिन् यज्ञे यजमानासुवस्वेन्द्राय देवेभ्यो जुहुता हविः स्वाहा
21.10.m: 'O divine Savitṛ, bestow good impulse today in this sacrifice for the sacrificer; for Indra, for the gods, sacrifice the oblation, svāhā!'

21.10.s: deva dhātaḥ sudhātādyāsmin yajñe yajamānāyaidhīndrāya devebhyo juhutā haviḥ svāhā
21.10.d: देव धातः सुधाताद्यास्मिन् यज्ञे यजमानायैधीन्द्राय देवेभ्यो जुहुता हविः स्वाहा
21.10.m: 'O divine Dhātṛ, be a good supporter today in this sacrifice for the sacrificer; for Indra, for the gods, sacrifice the oblation, svāhā!'

21.10.s: devā grāvāṇo madhumatīm adyāsmin yajñe yajamānāya vācaṃ vadatendrāya devebhyo juhutā haviḥ svāhā
21.10.d: देवा ग्रावाणो मधुमतीम् अद्यास्मिन् यज्ञे यजमानाय वाचं वदतेन्द्राय देवेभ्यो जुहुता हविः स्वाहा
21.10.m: 'O divine pressing-stones, speak today in this sacrifice a honey-rich speech for the sacrificer; for Indra, for the gods, sacrifice the oblation, svāhā!'

21.10.s: devy anumate 'nvadyemaṃ yajñaṃ yajamānāya manyasvendrāya devebhyo juhutā haviḥ svāhā
21.10.d: देव्य् अनुमते ऽन्वद्येमं यज्ञं यजमानाय मन्यस्वेन्द्राय देवेभ्यो जुहुता हविः स्वाहा
21.10.m: 'O divine Anumati, approve today this sacrifice for the sacrificer; for Indra, for the gods, sacrifice the oblation, svāhā!'

21.10.s: devy adite svādityām adyāsmin yajñe yajamānāyāsuvasvendrāya devebhyo juhutā haviḥ svāhā
21.10.d: देव्य् अदिते स्वादित्याम् अद्यास्मिन् यज्ञे यजमानायासुवस्वेन्द्राय देवेभ्यो जुहुता हविः स्वाहा
21.10.m: 'O divine Aditi, impel good Aditi-like care today in this sacrifice for the sacrificer; for Indra, for the gods, sacrifice the oblation, svāhā!'

21.10.s: devya āpo nannamyadhvam adyāsmin yajñe yajamānāyendrāya devebhyo juhutā haviḥ svāhā
21.10.d: देव्य आपो नन्नम्यध्वम् अद्यास्मिन् यज्ञे यजमानायेन्द्राय देवेभ्यो जुहुता हविः स्वाहा
21.10.m: 'O divine Waters, bend down repeatedly today in this sacrifice for the sacrificer; for Indra, for the gods, sacrifice the oblation, svāhā!'

21.10.s: sadassadaḥ prajāvān ṛbhur juṣāṇa indrāya devebhyo juhutā havis svāhā
21.10.d: सदस्सदः प्रजावान् ऋभुर् जुषाण इन्द्राय देवेभ्यो जुहुता हविस् स्वाहा
21.10.m: 'Seated in the sadas, rich in offspring, let the Ṛbhu, being pleased, sacrifice the oblation for Indra, for the gods, svāhā!'

21.10.s: deva tvaṣṭaḥ suretodhā adyāsmin yajñe yajamānāyaidhīndrāya devebhyo juhutā haviḥ svāhā
21.10.d: देव त्वष्टः सुरेतोधा अद्यास्मिन् यज्ञे यजमानायैधीन्द्राय देवेभ्यो जुहुता हविः स्वाहा
21.10.m: 'O divine Tvaṣṭṛ, be a placer of good seed today in this sacrifice for the sacrificer; for Indra, for the gods, sacrifice the oblation, svāhā!'

21.10.s: āgneya ekakapāla āśvino dvikapālo vaiṣṇavas trikapālaḥ saumyaś catuṣkapālaḥ sāvitraḥ pañcakapālo dhātraḥ ṣaṭkapālo mārūtaḥ saptakapālo bārhaspatyo 'ṣṭākapālo maitro navakapālo vārūṇo daśakapāla aindra ekādaśakapālo vaiśvadevo dvādaśakapālaḥ
21.10.d: आग्नेय एककपाल आश्विनो द्विकपालो वैष्णवस् त्रिकपालः सौम्यश् चतुष्कपालः सावित्रः पञ्चकपालो धात्रः षट्कपालो मारूतः सप्तकपालो बार्हस्पत्यो ऽष्टाकपालो मैत्रो नवकपालो वारूणो दशकपाल ऐन्द्र एकादशकपालो वैश्वदेवो द्वादशकपालः
21.10.m: There is a single-cup cake for Agni, a two-cup cake for the Aśvins, a three-cup cake for Viṣṇu, a four-cup cake for Soma, a five-cup cake for Savitṛ, a six-cup cake for Dhātṛ, a seven-cup cake for the Maruts, an eight-cup cake for Bṛhaspati, a nine-cup cake for Mitra, a ten-cup cake for Varuṇa, an eleven-cup cake for Indra, a twelve-cup cake for the All-Gods.

21.11.s: trivṛta prātassavanaṃ pañcadaśaṃ mādhyandinaṃ savanaṃ saptadaśaṃ tṛtīyasavanaṃ pañcadaśaṃ prātassavanaṃ saptadaśaṃ mādhyandinaṃ savanam ekaviṃśaṃ tṛtīyasavanaṃ sokthaṃ saptadaśaṃ prātassavanam ekaviṃśaṃ mādhyandinaṃ savanaṃ triṇavaṃ tṛtīyasavanaṃ soktham ekaviṃśaṃ prātassavanaṃ triṇavaṃ mādhyandinaṃ savanaṃ trayastriṃśaṃ tṛtīyasavanaṃ pratyavarohīṇy ukthāni triṇavaṃ prathamaṃ dve ekaviṃśe saṣoḍaśike pañcadaśī rātris trivṛt sandhiḥ
21.11.d: त्रिवृत प्रातस्सवनं पञ्चदशं माध्यन्दिनं सवनं सप्तदशं तृतीयसवनं पञ्चदशं प्रातस्सवनं सप्तदशं माध्यन्दिनं सवनम् एकविंशं तृतीयसवनं सोक्थं सप्तदशं प्रातस्सवनम् एकविंशं माध्यन्दिनं सवनं त्रिणवं तृतीयसवनं सोक्थम् एकविंशं प्रातस्सवनं त्रिणवं माध्यन्दिनं सवनं त्रयस्त्रिंशं तृतीयसवनं प्रत्यवरोहीण्य् उक्थानि त्रिणवं प्रथमं द्वे एकविंशे सषोडशिके पञ्चदशी रात्रिस् त्रिवृत् सन्धिः
21.11.m: The morning pressing is ninefold, the midday pressing is fifteenfold, the third pressing is seventeenfold; the morning pressing is fifteenfold, the midday pressing is seventeenfold, the third pressing is twenty-one-fold, having ukthas; the morning pressing is seventeenfold, the midday pressing is twenty-one-fold, the third pressing is twenty-seven-fold, having ukthas; the morning pressing is twenty-one-fold, the midday pressing is twenty-seven-fold, the third pressing is thirty-three-fold; the ukthas are descending: the first is twenty-seven-fold, two are twenty-one-fold, with a sixteenfold chant; the night is fifteenfold; the twilight chant is ninefold.

21.11.s: vasiṣṭhaḥ putrahato hīna ivāmanyata sa etam apaśyat so 'graṃ paryaid yo hīna iva manyeta sa etena yajeta
21.11.d: वसिष्ठः पुत्रहतो हीन इवामन्यत स एतम् अपश्यत् सो ऽग्रं पर्यैद् यो हीन इव मन्येत स एतेन यजेत
21.11.m: Vasiṣṭha, his son having been slain, considered himself as if bereft. He saw this [rite]; he attained the summit. He who considers himself as if bereft should sacrifice with this.

21.11.s: yat stomāt stomam abhisaṃkrāmaty agrād evāgraṃ rohati vasiṣṭhasya janitre bhavataḥ prajātyai
21.11.d: यत् स्तोमात् स्तोमम् अभिसंक्रामत्य् अग्राद् एवाग्रं रोहति वसिष्ठस्य जनित्रे भवतः प्रजात्यै
21.11.m: Because he transitions from stoma to stoma, he ascends from summit to summit. The two [sāmans] of Vasiṣṭha's birth-place are [used] for procreation.
The ukthas of the last day are descending, for firm establishment.

21.12.s: trivṛd agniṣṭomaḥ pañcadaśa ukthaḥ saptadaśa uktha ekaviṃśo 'tirātro viśvāmitrasya sañjayaḥ
21.12.d: त्रिवृद् अग्निष्टोमः पञ्चदश उक्थः सप्तदश उक्थ एकविंशो ऽतिरात्रो विश्वामित्रस्य सञ्जयः
21.12.m: A ninefold agniṣṭoma, a fifteenfold uktha, a seventeenfold uktha, a twenty-one-fold atirātra—[this is] Viśvāmitra's complete victory.

21.12.s: jahnuvṛcīvanto rāṣṭra āhiṃsanta sa viśvāmitro jāhnavo rājaitam apaśyat sa rāṣṭram abhavad arāṣṭram itare
21.12.d: जह्नुवृचीवन्तो राष्ट्र आहिंसन्त स विश्वामित्रो जाह्नवो राजैतम् अपश्यत् स राष्ट्रम् अभवद् अराष्ट्रम् इतरे
21.12.m: The Jahnus and the Vṛcīvants were contending for the kingdom. King Viśvāmitra, the descendant of Jahnu, saw this [rite]. He became the kingdom; the others became kingdomless.

21.12.s: bhavaty ātmanā parāsya bhrātṛvyo bhavati ya evaṃ veda
21.12.d: भवत्य् आत्मना परास्य भ्रातृव्यो भवति य एवं वेद
21.12.m: He thrives in himself; his rival is defeated, who knows thus.

21.12.s: jyotiḥ prajānāṃ bhavati ya evaṃ veda
21.12.d: ज्योतिः प्रजानां भवति य एवं वेद
21.12.m: He becomes the light of creatures, who knows thus.

21.12.s: catuṣṭomo vā eṣa catuṣpādāḥ paśavaḥ paśuṣv eva pratitiṣṭhati
21.12.d: चतुष्टोमो वा एष चतुष्पादाः पशवः पशुष्व् एव प्रतितिष्ठति
21.12.m: This is a four-stoma [rite]. Cattle are four-footed. He firmly establishes himself in cattle.

21.12.s: ekaviṃśaṃ stomā nātiyanti pratiṣṭhā vā ekaviṃśo 'ntata eva yajñasya pratitiṣṭhati
21.12.d: एकविंशं स्तोमा नातियन्ति प्रतिष्ठा वा एकविंशो ऽन्तत एव यज्ञस्य प्रतितिष्ठति
21.12.m: The stomas do not exceed the twenty-one-fold. The twenty-one-fold [stoma] is indeed a firm standing; at the end of the sacrifice, he firmly establishes himself.

21.13.s: dve trivṛtī savane pañcadaśam ekaṃ dve pañcadaśe savane saptadaśam ekaṃ dve saptadaśe savane ekaviṃśam ekaṃ dve ekaviṃśe savane triṇavam ekaṃ dve triṇave savane trayastriṃśam ekaṃ pratyavarohīṇy ukthāni triṇavaṃ prathamaṃ dve ekaviṃśe saṣoḍaśike pañcadaśī rātris trivṛt sandhiḥ
21.13.d: द्वे त्रिवृती सवने पञ्चदशम् एकं द्वे पञ्चदशे सवने सप्तदशम् एकं द्वे सप्तदशे सवने एकविंशम् एकं द्वे एकविंशे सवने त्रिणवम् एकं द्वे त्रिणवे सवने त्रयस्त्रिंशम् एकं प्रत्यवरोहीण्य् उक्थानि त्रिणवं प्रथमं द्वे एकविंशे सषोडशिके पञ्चदशी रात्रिस् त्रिवृत् सन्धिः
21.13.m: Two pressings are ninefold, one is fifteenfold; two pressings are fifteenfold, one is seventeenfold; two pressings are seventeenfold, one is twenty-one-fold; two pressings are twenty-one-fold, one is twenty-seven-fold; two pressings are twenty-seven-fold, one is thirty-three-fold; the ukthas are descending: the first is twenty-seven-fold, two are twenty-one-fold, with a sixteenfold chant; the night is fifteenfold; the twilight chant is ninefold.

21.13.s: devāś ca vā asurāś cāspardhanta te na vyajayanta te 'bruvan vāco mithunena vijayāmahai yatare no vāco mithunaṃ na prativindāṃs te parā bhavān iti te devā eka ity abruvann ekety asurā vāco mithunaṃ pratyavindan dvāv iti devā abruvan dve ity asurā vāco mithunaṃ pratyavindanaṃs traya iti devā abruvaṃs tisra ity asurā vāco mithunaṃ pratyavindaṃś catvāra iti devā abruvaṃś catastra ity asurā vāco mithunaṃ pratyavindan pañceti devā abruvan nāsurā avindaṃs tato devā abhavan parāsurāḥ
21.13.d: देवाश् च वा असुराश् चास्पर्धन्त ते न व्यजयन्त ते ऽब्रुवन् वाचो मिथुनेन विजयामहै यतरे नो वाचो मिथुनं न प्रतिविन्दांस् ते परा भवान् इति ते देवा एक इत्य् अब्रुवन्न् एकेत्य् असुरा वाचो मिथुनं प्रत्यविन्दन् द्वाव् इति देवा अब्रुवन् द्वे इत्य् असुरा वाचो मिथुनं प्रत्यविन्दनंस् त्रय इति देवा अब्रुवंस् तिस्र इत्य् असुरा वाचो मिथुनं प्रत्यविन्दंश् चत्वार इति देवा अब्रुवंश् चतस्त्र इत्य् असुरा वाचो मिथुनं प्रत्यविन्दन् पञ्चेति देवा अब्रुवन् नासुरा अविन्दंस् ततो देवा अभवन् परासुराः
21.13.m: The gods and the asuras were contending. They could not win. They said: 'Let us win by the pair of Speech. Whichever [party] among us cannot find the matching pair of Speech, they shall be defeated.' The gods said: 'Ekaḥ' [one, masculine]; the asuras found the matching pair of Speech: 'Ekā' [one, feminine]. The gods said: 'Dvau' [two, masculine]; the asuras found the matching pair of Speech: 'Dve' [two, feminine]. The gods said: 'Trayaḥ' [three, masculine]; the asuras found the matching pair of Speech: 'Tisraḥ' [three, feminine]. The gods said: 'Catvāraḥ' [four, masculine]; the asuras found the matching pair of Speech: 'Catasraḥ' [four, feminine]. The gods said: 'Pañca' [five]; the asuras could not find [a pair]. Thereupon the gods prevailed; the asuras were defeated.

21.13.s: bhavaty ātmanā parāsya bhrātṛvyo bhavati ya evaṃ veda
21.13.d: भवत्य् आत्मना परास्य भ्रातृव्यो भवति य एवं वेद
21.13.m: He thrives in himself; his rival is defeated, who knows thus.

21.13.s: saṃvatsaraṃ vā eṣāṃ tad vīryam annādyam avṛñjata
21.13.d: संवत्सरं वा एषां तद् वीर्यम् अन्नाद्यम् अवृञ्जत
21.13.m: They wrested their year's virility and food.

21.13.s: saṃvatsaraṃ vīryam annādyaṃ bhrātṛvyasya vṛṅkte ya evaṃ veda
21.13.d: संवत्सरं वीर्यम् अन्नाद्यं भ्रातृव्यस्य वृङ्क्ते य एवं वेद
21.13.m: He wrests the year's virility and food of his rival, who knows thus.

21.13.s: pañcarātro vā eṣa pāṅktaḥ purūṣaḥ pāṅktāḥ paśavas tena purūṣaṃ ca paśūṃś cāpnoti
21.13.d: पञ्चरात्रो वा एष पाङ्क्तः पुरूषः पाङ्क्ताः पशवस् तेन पुरूषं च पशूंश् चाप्नोति
21.13.m: This is a five-day rite. Man is fivefold; cattle are fivefold. Thereby he obtains both man and cattle.

21.13.s: āstharir vā eṣa santato yajño dvau dvau hi stomāv ahar vahato yaṃ kāmaṃ kāmayate tam etenābhyaśnute
21.13.d: आस्थरिर् वा एष सन्ततो यज्ञो द्वौ द्वौ हि स्तोमाव् अहर् वहतो यं कामं कामयते तम् एतेनाभ्यश्नुते
21.13.m: This continuous sacrifice is non-one-horse [yoked in pairs]; for two stomas each carry a day. Whatever desire he desires, he attains by this.

21.13.s: yatra yatra hy asthūriṇā kāmayate tat tad abhyaśnute
21.13.d: यत्र यत्र ह्य् अस्थूरिणा कामयते तत् तद् अभ्यश्नुते
21.13.m: For wherever one desires [to go] with a span [of two horses], there he reaches.
The five-day rite is linked [from day to day], for continuity.
Descending are the uktha [stotras] of the final day, for firm support.

21.14.s: trivṛd agniṣṭomaḥ pañcadaśa ukthaḥ saptadaśa ukthaḥ pañcadaśa ukthaḥ saptadaśo 'tirātraḥ pañcaśāradīyo marutāṃ stomaḥ
21.14.d: त्रिवृद् अग्निष्टोमः पञ्चदश उक्थः सप्तदश उक्थः पञ्चदश उक्थः सप्तदशो ऽतिरात्रः पञ्चशारदीयो मरुतां स्तोमः
21.14.m: A ninefold agniṣṭoma, a fifteenfold ukthya, a seventeenfold ukthya, a fifteenfold ukthya, a seventeenfold atirātra: [this is] the Pañcaśāradīya, the stoma of the Maruts.

21.14.s: yaḥ kāmayeta bahu syām iti sa etena yajeta
21.14.d: यः कामयेत बहु स्याम् इति स एतेन यजेत
21.14.m: He who desires, 'May I become manifold,' should sacrifice with this.

21.14.s: marūto vai devānāṃ bhūyiṣṭhā bahur eva bhavati
21.14.d: मरूतो वै देवानां भूयिष्ठा बहुर् एव भवति
21.14.m: The Maruts indeed are the most numerous of the gods; he becomes manifold indeed.

21.14.s: saptadaśaṃ stomā nātiyanti prajāpatir vai saptadaśaḥ prajāpatim evāpnoti
21.14.d: सप्तदशं स्तोमा नातियन्ति प्रजापतिर् वै सप्तदशः प्रजापतिम् एवाप्नोति
21.14.m: The stomas do not exceed the seventeenfold; Prajāpati is seventeenfold; he reaches Prajāpati himself.

21.14.s: agastyo vai marūdbhya ukṣṇaḥ praukṣat tān indrāyābadhnāt te vajram ādāyābhyapatan sa etat kayāśubhīyam apaśyat tenāśamayat
21.14.d: अगस्त्यो वै मरूद्भ्य उक्ष्णः प्रौक्षत् तान् इन्द्रायाबध्नात् ते वज्रम् आदायाभ्यपतन् स एतत् कयाशुभीयम् अपश्यत् तेनाशमयत्
21.14.m: Agastya consecrated bulls for the Maruts; he tied them for Indra. Taking the thunderbolt, they flew at him. He saw this Kayāśubhīya [hymn]; with it he pacified [them].

21.14.s: yat kayāśubhīyaṃ śasyate śāntyā eva
21.14.d: यत् कयाशुभीयं शस्यते शान्त्या एव
21.14.m: In that the Kayāśubhīya is recited, it is for pacification.

21.14.s: saptadaśa pṛśnīn ukṣṇaḥ pañcavarṣān saptadaśa pṛśnīs trivatsā apravītās tān paryagnikṛtān prokṣitānetarā labhante pretarān sṛjanti
21.14.d: सप्तदश पृश्नीन् उक्ष्णः पञ्चवर्षान् सप्तदश पृश्नीस् त्रिवत्सा अप्रवीतास् तान् पर्यग्निकृतान् प्रोक्षितानेतरा लभन्ते प्रेतरान् सृजन्ति
21.14.m: Seventeen spotted bulls of five years [and] seventeen unserved spotted three-year-old heifers: having carried fire around them and sprinkled them, they seize the one set, [and] release the other set.

21.14.s: tataḥ saṃvatsare navanītapṛśnīr arūṇā ānayanti tāṃś caivokṣṇas tān paryagnikṛtān prokṣitān etarā labhante pretarān sṛjanti tataḥ saṃvatsare rājīvā ānayanti tāṃś caivokṣṇas tān paryagnikṛtān prokṣitān etarā labhante pretarān sṛjanti tataḥ saṃvatsare piśaṅgīr ānayanti tāṃś caivokṣṇas tān paryagnikṛtān prokṣitān etarā labhante pretarān sṛjanti tataḥ saṃvatsare sāraṅgīr ānayanti tāṃś caivokṣṇas tān paryagnikṛtān pokṣitān etarā labhante pretarān sṛjanti
21.14.d: ततः संवत्सरे नवनीतपृश्नीर् अरूणा आनयन्ति तांश् चैवोक्ष्णस् तान् पर्यग्निकृतान् प्रोक्षितान् एतरा लभन्ते प्रेतरान् सृजन्ति ततः संवत्सरे राजीवा आनयन्ति तांश् चैवोक्ष्णस् तान् पर्यग्निकृतान् प्रोक्षितान् एतरा लभन्ते प्रेतरान् सृजन्ति ततः संवत्सरे पिशङ्गीर् आनयन्ति तांश् चैवोक्ष्णस् तान् पर्यग्निकृतान् प्रोक्षितान् एतरा लभन्ते प्रेतरान् सृजन्ति ततः संवत्सरे सारङ्गीर् आनयन्ति तांश् चैवोक्ष्णस् तान् पर्यग्निकृतान् पोक्षितान् एतरा लभन्ते प्रेतरान् सृजन्ति
21.14.m:
Then, after a year, they bring butter-spotted reddish [heifers] and the same bulls; having carried fire around them and sprinkled them, they seize the one set, [and] release the other set. Then, after a year, they bring striped [heifers] and the same bulls; having carried fire around them and sprinkled them, they seize the one set, [and] release the other set. Then, after a year, they bring tawny [heifers] and the same bulls; having carried fire around them and sprinkled them, they seize the one set, [and] release the other set. Then, after a year, they bring dappled [heifers] and the same bulls; having carried fire around them and sprinkled them, they seize the one set, [and] release the other set.

Then, after a year, the Soma [days] take place.

21.14.s: tataḥ saṃvatsare somā bhavanti
21.14.d: ततः संवत्सरे सोमा भवन्ति

21.14.s: trīṃs trīn anvaham ālabhante pañcottame 'hani
21.14.d: त्रींस् त्रीन् अन्वहम् आलभन्ते पञ्चोत्तमे ऽहनि
21.14.m: Day after day they seize three each; five on the final day.

21.14.s: ajo 'gnīṣomīyaḥ
21.14.d: अजो ऽग्नीषोमीयः

21.14.s: aindrā mārūto ukṣāṇo mārūtyo vatsataryaḥ
21.14.d: ऐन्द्रा मारूतो उक्षाणो मारूत्यो वत्सतर्यः
21.14.m: The bulls belong to Indra and the Maruts; the heifers belong to the Maruts.

21.14.s: yadi rūdro 'bhimanyotāgnaye rūdravate puroḍāśam aṣṭākapālaṃ nirūpyāthānyam ālabheta
21.14.d: यदि रूद्रो ऽभिमन्योताग्नये रूद्रवते पुरोडाशम् अष्टाकपालं निरूप्याथान्यम् आलभेत
21.14.m: If Rudra should assail [one of them], having assigned an eight-pot-sherd cake to Agni possessed of Rudra, one should then seize another.

21.14.s: yadi saṃśīryaita bhaumam ekakapālaṃ nirūpyāthānyam ālabheta
21.14.d: यदि संशीर्यैत भौमम् एककपालं निरूप्याथान्यम् आलभेत
21.14.m: If [one] should break down, having assigned a one-pot-sherd [cake] to Bhūmi, one should then seize another.

21.14.s: yady avasīder nairṛtaṃ caruṃ nirūpyāthānyam ālabheta yady apsu mriyetāponaptrīyaṃ caruṃ nirūpyāthānyam ālabheta yady andhasyāt sauryaṃ caruṃ nirūpyāthānyam ālabheta
21.14.d: यद्य् अवसीदेर् नैरृतं चरुं निरूप्याथान्यम् आलभेत यद्य् अप्सु म्रियेतापोनप्त्रीयं चरुं निरूप्याथान्यम् आलभेत यद्य् अन्धस्यात् सौर्यं चरुं निरूप्याथान्यम् आलभेत
21.14.m: If [one] should collapse, having assigned a mess [of boiled rice] to Nirṛti, one should then seize another. If [one] should die in the waters, having assigned a mess to Apāṃ Napāt, one should then seize another. If [one] should become blind, having assigned a mess to Sūrya, one should then seize another.

21.14.s: yadi ślavaṇo vā kuṭo vā syād bārhaspatyaṃ caruṃ nipyāthānyam ālabheta
21.14.d: यदि श्लवणो वा कुटो वा स्याद् बार्हस्पत्यं चरुं निप्याथान्यम् आलभेत
21.14.m: If it should be one-eared or hornless, having assigned a mess to Bṛhaspati, one should then seize another.

21.14.s: yadi palāyeta vāyavyaṃ caruṃ nirūpyāthānyam ālabheta
21.14.d: यदि पलायेत वायव्यं चरुं निरूप्याथान्यम् आलभेत
21.14.m: If it should run away, having assigned a mess to Vāyu, one should then seize another.

21.14.s: yadi prāsahājayeyur indrāya prasahvana ekādaśakapālaṃ nirūpyāthānyam ālabheta
21.14.d: यदि प्रासहाजयेयुर् इन्द्राय प्रसह्वन एकादशकपालं निरूप्याथान्यम् आलभेत
21.14.m: If [enemies] should carry it off by force, having assigned an eleven-pot-sherd [cake] to Indra Prasahvan, one should then seize another.

21.14.s: yady anyena mṛtyunā mriyeta prājāpatyaṃ dvādaśakapālaṃ nirūpyāthānyam ālabheta
21.14.d: यद्य् अन्येन मृत्युना म्रियेत प्राजापत्यं द्वादशकपालं निरूप्याथान्यम् आलभेत
21.14.m: If it should die by another death, having assigned a twelve-pot-sherd [cake] to Prajāpati, one should then seize another.

21.14.s: etena vā ekayāvā gāndamo vetasvatīṣṭvā sarvām ṛddhim ārdhnot
21.14.d: एतेन वा एकयावा गान्दमो वेतस्वतीष्ट्वा सर्वाम् ऋद्धिम् आर्ध्नोत्
21.14.m: By this [rite], having sacrificed on the Vetasvatī, Ekayāvā Gāndama prospered in all prosperity.

21.14.s: sarvām ṛddhim ṛdhnoti ya evaṃ veda
21.14.d: सर्वाम् ऋद्धिम् ऋध्नोति य एवं वेद
21.14.m: He prospers in all prosperity who knows thus.

21.15.s: jyotiṣṭomo 'gniṣṭomo gaur ukthyo mahāvrataṃ gaur ukthya āyur atirātraḥ
21.15.d: ज्योतिष्टोमो ऽग्निष्टोमो गौर् उक्थ्यो महाव्रतं गौर् उक्थ्य आयुर् अतिरात्रः
21.15.m: A Jyotiṣṭoma agniṣṭoma, a Go ukthya, the Mahāvrata, a Go ukthya, an Āyus atirātra.

21.15.s: saṃvatsaro vai vrataṃ tasya vasanta ṛtur mukhaṃ grīṣmaś ca varṣāś ca pakṣau śaran madhyaṃ hemantaḥ puccham
21.15.d: संवत्सरो वै व्रतं तस्य वसन्त ऋतुर् मुखं ग्रीष्मश् च वर्षाश् च पक्षौ शरन् मध्यं हेमन्तः पुच्छम्
21.15.m: The year indeed is the Vrata; the spring season is its head, summer and the rains are the two wings, autumn is the middle, winter is the tail.

21.15.s: tasmāc charadam oṣadhayo 'bhisampacyante śarad dhi madhyaṃ saṃvatsarasya
21.15.d: तस्माच् छरदम् ओषधयो ऽभिसम्पच्यन्ते शरद् धि मध्यं संवत्सरस्य
21.15.m: Therefore plants ripen fully in autumn, for autumn is the middle of the year.

21.15.s: akṛtaṃ vā ete kurvanti ye purā saṃvatsarāt vratam upayanti
21.15.d: अकृतं वा एते कुर्वन्ति ये पुरा संवत्सरात् व्रतम् उपयन्ति
21.15.m: Those who undertake the Vrata before a year perform what is incomplete.

21.15.s: etad vai vratam āptaṃ yat pañcarātre pañca hy ṛtavaḥ
21.15.d: एतद् वै व्रतम् आप्तं यत् पञ्चरात्रे पञ्च ह्य् ऋतवः
21.15.m: This Vrata is attained when it is in a five-day rite, for there are five seasons.

21.15.s: āptena vratena stute sarvam āyur eti ya evaṃ veda
21.15.d: आप्तेन व्रतेन स्तुते सर्वम् आयुर् एति य एवं वेद
21.15.m: He is praised with an attained Vrata; he attains a complete lifespan who knows thus.

22.1.s: ṛtavo na pratyatiṣṭhaṃs ta etena pratyatiṣṭhan pratiṣṭhākāmo yajeta praty eva tiṣṭhati
22.1.d: ऋतवो न प्रत्यतिष्ठंस् त एतेन प्रत्यतिष्ठन् प्रतिष्ठाकामो यजेत प्रत्य् एव तिष्ठति
22.1.m: The seasons were not firmly established; through this they were firmly established. One desiring firm support should sacrifice; he is firmly supported indeed.

22.1.s: ṣaḍ vā ṛtava ṛtuṣv evaitena pratitiṣṭhati pṛṣṭhayaḥ ṣaḍaho bhavati pratyakṣam ṛdhyai
22.1.d: षड् वा ऋतव ऋतुष्व् एवैतेन प्रतितिष्ठति पृष्ठयः षडहो भवति प्रत्यक्षम् ऋध्यै
22.1.m: Six indeed are the seasons; in the seasons he is firmly established through this. There is a Pṛṣṭhya six-day rite visibly for prosperity.

22.1.s: pratyakṣaṃ hy etenartava ārdhnuvann ṛdhyā eva
22.1.d: प्रत्यक्षं ह्य् एतेनर्तव आर्ध्नुवन्न् ऋध्या एव
22.1.m: For visibly through this did the seasons prosper, for prosperity.

22.2.s: trivṛd agniṣṭomaḥ pañcadaśa ukthyaḥ saptadaśa ukthyo jyotir gaur āyur atirātraḥ
22.2.d: त्रिवृद् अग्निष्टोमः पञ्चदश उक्थ्यः सप्तदश उक्थ्यो ज्योतिर् गौर् आयुर् अतिरात्रः
22.2.m: A ninefold agniṣṭoma, a fifteenfold ukthya, a seventeenfold ukthya, a Jyotis, a Go, an Āyus atirātra.

22.2.s: yaḥ kāmayeta sarvam āyur iyām iti sa etena yajeta
22.2.d: यः कामयेत सर्वम् आयुर् इयाम् इति स एतेन यजेत
22.2.m: He who desires, 'May I attain a complete lifespan,' should sacrifice with this.

22.2.s: yat tryahaḥ purastād bhavati trayaḥ prāṇāpānavyānās ta eva tat saṃdhīyante
22.2.d: यत् त्र्यहः पुरस्ताद् भवति त्रयः प्राणापानव्यानास् त एव तत् संधीयन्ते
22.2.m: In that there is a three-day period in front, there are three [vital breaths]: out-breath, in-breath, and diffused breath; these indeed are thereby joined together.

22.2.s: atha yat jyotir gaur āyur atirātro bhavati pratiṣṭhityai
22.2.d: अथ यत् ज्योतिर् गौर् आयुर् अतिरात्रो भवति प्रतिष्ठित्यै
22.2.m: Then, in that there are the Jyotis, the Go, and the Āyus atirātra, it is for firm support.

22.3.m: The intertwining five-day rite, [and] a Viśvajit atirātra.

22.3.s: anyasmai vai kāmāya sattram anyasmai yajño na tatsatreṇāpnoti yasmaikaṃ yajño na tad yajñenāpnoti yasmaikaṃ sattram
22.3.d: अन्यस्मै वै कामाय सत्त्रम् अन्यस्मै यज्ञो न तत्सत्रेणाप्नोति यस्मैकं यज्ञो न तद् यज्ञेनाप्नोति यस्मैकं सत्त्रम्
22.3.m: For one desire indeed is the sacrificial session, for another is the sacrifice. That for which a sacrificial session [is performed] one does not attain by a sacrifice; that for which a sacrifice [is performed] one does not attain by a sacrificial session.

22.3.s: sattram iva vā etad yad anulomaṃ pṛṣṭhāni yad ekadhā pṛṣṭhāni bhavanty ekadhaivāsmiṃs tad ojo vīryaṃ dadhāti
22.3.d: सत्त्रम् इव वा एतद् यद् अनुलोमं पृष्ठानि यद् एकधा पृष्ठानि भवन्त्य् एकधैवास्मिंस् तद् ओजो वीर्यं दधाति
22.3.m: Like a sacrificial session indeed is this when the pṛṣṭhas are in regular order. In that the pṛṣṭhas become uniform, he places vigour and valour in him in a uniform way.
Food is the pṛṣṭhas; he places food in him.
Cattle are the pṛṣṭhas; he is firmly established in cattle.
There is an intertwining five-day rite for continuity.
There is a Viśvajit atirātra for conquering all.

22.4.m: A Pṛṣṭhya six-day rite, [and] the Mahāvrata atirātra.

22.4.s: sapta ṛṣaya etenārdhnuvaṃs tenarddhis tasmād etena yajanta ṛddhyā eva
22.4.d: सप्त ऋषय एतेनार्ध्नुवंस् तेनर्द्धिस् तस्माद् एतेन यजन्त ऋद्ध्या एव
22.4.m: The seven seers prospered through this; through it there was prosperity. Therefore they sacrifice with this, for prosperity.

22.4.s: sapta śirasi prāṇāḥ prāṇā indriyāṇīndriyāṇy evaitenāpnoti
22.4.d: सप्त शिरसि प्राणाः प्राणा इन्द्रियाणीन्द्रियाण्य् एवैतेनाप्नोति
22.4.m: Seven are the vital breaths in the head; the vital breaths are the faculties; faculties indeed does he attain through this.
Seven are the domestic cattle; these he attains through this.

22.4.s: vrataṃ saptamasyāhnaḥ pṛṣṭhaṃ bhavati tad dhy anāptam annaṃ vai vratam annādyam evaitenāpnoti
22.4.d: व्रतं सप्तमस्याह्नः पृष्ठं भवति तद् ध्य् अनाप्तम् अन्नं वै व्रतम् अन्नाद्यम् एवैतेनाप्नोति
22.4.m: The Vrata is the pṛṣṭha of the seventh day, for it is unattained. Food indeed is the Vrata; food he attains through this.
There is a Pṛṣṭhya six-day rite visibly for prosperity.

22.4.s: pratyakṣaṃ hy etena sapta ṛṣaya ārdhnuvann ṛdhyā eva
22.4.d: प्रत्यक्षं ह्य् एतेन सप्त ऋषय आर्ध्नुवन्न् ऋध्या एव
22.4.m: For visibly through this did the seven seers prosper, for prosperity.

22.5.m: A Pṛṣṭhya six-day rite, a seventeenfold Mahāvrata, an atirātra.

22.5.s: tasya trivṛc chiraḥ pañcadaśau pakṣau saptadaśa ātmaikaviṃśaṃ puccham
22.5.d: तस्य त्रिवृच् छिरः पञ्चदशौ पक्षौ सप्तदश आत्मैकविंशं पुच्छम्
22.5.m: Its head is ninefold, the two wings fifteenfold, the trunk seventeenfold, the tail twenty-one-fold.
Through this indeed did Prajāpati create offspring.

22.5.s: pra prajayā pra paśubhir jāyate ya evaṃ veda
22.5.d: प्र प्रजया प्र पशुभिर् जायते य एवं वेद
22.5.m: He propagates with offspring and with cattle who knows thus.

22.5.s: saptadaśo vai prajāpatir yat saptadaśaṃ vrataṃ bhavati prajāpatim evāpnoti
22.5.d: सप्तदशो वै प्रजापतिर् यत् सप्तदशं व्रतं भवति प्रजापतिम् एवाप्नोति
22.5.m: Seventeenfold indeed is Prajāpati; in that the Vrata is seventeenfold, he reaches Prajāpati himself.

22.5.s: yat trivṛc chiro bhavati nava prāṇāḥ prāṇeṣv eva prati tiṣṭhati
22.5.d: यत् त्रिवृच् छिरो भवति नव प्राणाः प्राणेष्व् एव प्रति तिष्ठति
22.5.m: In that the head is ninefold, nine are the vital breaths; he is firmly established in the vital breaths.
In that the two wings are fifteenfold, [it is] for the balance of the shoulder-yoke.

22.5.s: saptadaśa ātmā bhavati prajāpatir vai saptadaśaḥ prajā patim evāpnoti
22.5.d: सप्तदश आत्मा भवति प्रजापतिर् वै सप्तदशः प्रजा पतिम् एवाप्नोति
22.5.m: The trunk is seventeenfold; Prajāpati is seventeenfold; he reaches Prajāpati himself.
The tail is twenty-one-fold, for firm support.

22.6.m: A Pṛṣṭhya six-day rite, a Mahāvrata with chandoma-pavamānas, an atirātra.

22.6.s: yac chadomāḥ pavamānā mahāvratasya bhavanti paśūnevāvarūndhe
22.6.d: यच् छदोमाः पवमाना महाव्रतस्य भवन्ति पशूनेवावरून्धे
22.6.m: When the chandoma [sāmans] become the Pavamāna [chants] of the Mahāvrata, he obtains cattle.

22.6.s: ubhaye stomā yugmantaś cāyujaś ca tan mithunaṃ tasmān mithunāt prajāyate
22.6.d: उभये स्तोमा युग्मन्तश् चायुजश् च तन् मिथुनं तस्मान् मिथुनात् प्रजायते
22.6.m: Both [kinds of] stomas [are used], even and odd. That is a pair; from that pair he propagates.

22.7.s: abhyāsaṅgyaḥ pañcāho 'tha trayastriṃśām ahas tasya catustriṃśo 'gniṣṭomaḥ saptadaśaṃ mahāvratam atirātras tasya caturviṃśaṃ bahiṣpavamānaṃ trivṛc chiraḥ pañcadaśau pakṣau saptadaśa ātmaikaviṃśaṃ puccham
22.7.d: अभ्यासङ्ग्यः पञ्चाहो ऽथ त्रयस्त्रिंशाम् अहस् तस्य चतुस्त्रिंशो ऽग्निष्टोमः सप्तदशं महाव्रतम् अतिरात्रस् तस्य चतुर्विंशं बहिष्पवमानं त्रिवृच् छिरः पञ्चदशौ पक्षौ सप्तदश आत्मैकविंशं पुच्छम्
22.7.m: The contiguous five-day rite; then the thirty-third day; its agniṣṭoma is thirty-four-fold; the seventeenfold Mahāvrata; an atirātra. Its Bahiṣpavamāna is twenty-four-fold; the ninefold stoma is the head; two fifteenfold stomas are the two wings; the seventeenfold stoma is the body; the twenty-one-fold stoma is the tail.

22.7.s: etena vai jamadagniḥ sarvān poṣān apuṣyat sarvān evaitena poṣān puṣyati
22.7.d: एतेन वै जमदग्निः सर्वान् पोषान् अपुष्यत् सर्वान् एवैतेन पोषान् पुष्यति
22.7.m: By this indeed Jamadagni flourished in all prosperities; by this one flourishes in all prosperities.

22.7.s: yad abhyāsaṅgyaḥ pañcāhaḥ purastād bhavati santatyā eva
22.7.d: यद् अभ्यासङ्ग्यः पञ्चाहः पुरस्ताद् भवति सन्तत्या एव
22.7.m: That the contiguous five-day rite is in the beginning is for continuity.

22.7.s: athaitat trayastriṃśam ahas trayastriṃśad devatā devatā evāpnoti
22.7.d: अथैतत् त्रयस्त्रिंशम् अहस् त्रयस्त्रिंशद् देवता देवता एवाप्नोति
22.7.m: Then this thirty-third day: there are thirty-three deities; he obtains the deities.

22.7.s: tasya catustriṃśo 'gniṣṭomaḥ prajāpatiś catustriṃśo devatānāṃ prajāpatim evāpnoti
22.7.d: तस्य चतुस्त्रिंशो ऽग्निष्टोमः प्रजापतिश् चतुस्त्रिंशो देवतानां प्रजापतिम् एवाप्नोति
22.7.m: Its agniṣṭoma is thirty-four-fold: Prajāpati is the thirty-fourth of the deities; he obtains Prajāpati.

22.7.s: caturviṃśaṃ bahiṣpavamānaṃ bhavati mahāvratasya caturviṃśatyakṣarā gāyatrī prajananaṃ gāyatrī prajātyai
22.7.d: चतुर्विंशं बहिष्पवमानं भवति महाव्रतस्य चतुर्विंशत्यक्षरा गायत्री प्रजननं गायत्री प्रजात्यै
22.7.m: The Bahiṣpavamāna of the Mahāvrata is twenty-four-fold: the gāyatrī has twenty-four syllables; the gāyatrī is procreative; [it is] for procreation.

22.7.s: ubhaye stomā yugmantaś cāyujaś ca tan mithunaṃ tasmān mithunāt prajāyate
22.7.d: उभये स्तोमा युग्मन्तश् चायुजश् च तन् मिथुनं तस्मान् मिथुनात् प्रजायते
22.7.m: Both [kinds of] stomas [are used], even and odd. That is a pair; from that pair he propagates.

22.7.s: yat trivṛc chiro bhavati nava prāṇāḥ prāṇeṣv eva pratitiṣṭhati yat pañcadaśau pakṣau savīvadhatvāya saptadaśa ātmā bhavati prajāpatir vai saptadaśaḥ prajāpatim evāpnoty ekaviṃśaṃ pucchaṃ bhavati pratiṣṭhityai
22.7.d: यत् त्रिवृच् छिरो भवति नव प्राणाः प्राणेष्व् एव प्रतितिष्ठति यत् पञ्चदशौ पक्षौ सवीवधत्वाय सप्तदश आत्मा भवति प्रजापतिर् वै सप्तदशः प्रजापतिम् एवाप्नोत्य् एकविंशं पुच्छं भवति प्रतिष्ठित्यै
22.7.m: That the ninefold stoma is the head, there are nine vital breaths; he is established in the vital breaths. That two fifteenfold stomas are the two wings is for balance. The seventeenfold stoma is the body: Prajāpati is seventeenfold; he obtains Prajāpati. The twenty-one-fold stoma is the tail, for firm establishment.

22.8.s: jyotiṣṭomo 'gniṣṭomo gaur ukthya āyur ukthyo 'bhijid agniṣṭomo viśvajid agniṣṭomaḥ sarvajid agniṣṭomaḥ sarvastomo 'tirātraḥ
22.8.d: ज्योतिष्टोमो ऽग्निष्टोमो गौर् उक्थ्य आयुर् उक्थ्यो ऽभिजिद् अग्निष्टोमो विश्वजिद् अग्निष्टोमः सर्वजिद् अग्निष्टोमः सर्वस्तोमो ऽतिरात्रः
22.8.m: The Jyotiṣṭoma agniṣṭoma, the Go ukthya, the Āyus ukthya, the Abhijit agniṣṭoma, the Viśvajit agniṣṭoma, the Sarvajit agniṣṭoma, the all-stoma atirātra.

22.8.s: etena vā indro 'ty ānyā devatā abhavad aty anyā prajā bhavati ya evaṃ veda
22.8.d: एतेन वा इन्द्रो ऽत्य् आन्या देवता अभवद् अत्य् अन्या प्रजा भवति य एवं वेद
22.8.m: By this indeed Indra surpassed the other deities. He who knows this surpasses other creatures.

22.8.s: yat jyotir gaur āyus tryahaḥ purastād bhavati prajñātān stomānupaitīmān eva lokān eṣv eva lokeṣu pratitiṣṭhati
22.8.d: यत् ज्योतिर् गौर् आयुस् त्र्यहः पुरस्ताद् भवति प्रज्ञातान् स्तोमानुपैतीमान् एव लोकान् एष्व् एव लोकेषु प्रतितिष्ठति
22.8.m: That the Jyotis, Go, and Āyus three-day rite is in the beginning: he enters upon well-known stomas, these worlds; he is established in these worlds.

22.8.s: athābhijid abhijitā vai devā imān lokān abhyajayan viśvajitā viśvam ajayan sarvajitā sarvam ajayan
22.8.d: अथाभिजिद् अभिजिता वै देवा इमान् लोकान् अभ्यजयन् विश्वजिता विश्वम् अजयन् सर्वजिता सर्वम् अजयन्
22.8.m: Then the Abhijit: by the Abhijit indeed the gods conquered these worlds; by the Viśvajit they conquered the universe; by the Sarvajit they conquered all.

22.8.s: sarvastomātirātro bhavati sarvasyāptyai sarvasya jityai sarvam evaitenāpnoti sarvaṃ jayati
22.8.d: सर्वस्तोमातिरात्रो भवति सर्वस्याप्त्यै सर्वस्य जित्यै सर्वम् एवैतेनाप्नोति सर्वं जयति
22.8.m: There is an all-stoma atirātra, for the attainment of all, for the victory of all. By this he attains all, he conquers all.

22.9.s: catvāri trivṛnty ahāny agniṣṭomamukhāni viśvajin mahāvrataṃ jyotiṣṭomo 'tirātraḥ
22.9.d: चत्वारि त्रिवृन्त्य् अहान्य् अग्निष्टोममुखानि विश्वजिन् महाव्रतं ज्योतिष्टोमो ऽतिरात्रः
22.9.m: Four ninefold days beginning with the agniṣṭoma, the Viśvajit, the Mahāvrata, the Jyotiṣṭoma atirātra.

22.9.s: etena vai prajāpatiḥ purūṣam asṛjata sa sarvasyānnādyasyādhipatyam agacchat
22.9.d: एतेन वै प्रजापतिः पुरूषम् असृजत स सर्वस्यान्नाद्यस्याधिपत्यम् अगच्छत्
22.9.m:
By this indeed Prajāpati created man; he attained lordship over all food.

He who knows this attains lordship over all food.

22.9.s: śiro vā agre sambhavataḥ sambhavati caturdhā vihitaṃ vai śiraḥ prāṇaś cakṣuḥ śrotraṃ vāgātmā vai pṛṣṭhāni yat pṛṣṭhāny upaiti śira evātmānam anusandadhāti
22.9.d: शिरो वा अग्रे सम्भवतः सम्भवति चतुर्धा विहितं वै शिरः प्राणश् चक्षुः श्रोत्रं वागात्मा वै पृष्ठानि यत् पृष्ठान्य् उपैति शिर एवात्मानम् अनुसन्दधाति
22.9.m: The head indeed is first formed when [a fetus] is formed. Fourfold indeed is the head constituted: breath, eye, ear, and speech. The body indeed is the pṛṣṭhas. When he approaches the pṛṣṭhas, he connects the body following the head.

22.9.s: etad vai purūṣam akas tasmā annam eva vratam apidadhāti
22.9.d: एतद् वै पुरूषम् अकस् तस्मा अन्नम् एव व्रतम् अपिदधाति
22.9.m: This indeed made man; upon him he covers food as the vow [vrata].

22.9.s: atha yat jyotiṣṭomo 'tirātro bhavaty akḷptasya kḷptyai
22.9.d: अथ यत् ज्योतिष्टोमो ऽतिरात्रो भवत्य् अकॢप्तस्य कॢप्त्यै
22.9.m: Now, that there is the Jyotiṣṭoma atirātra is for the ordering of the disordered.

22.10.m: The pṛṣṭha stoma six-day rite, the Viśvajit atirātra.

22.10.s: anyasmai vai kāmāya sattram anyasmai yajño na tat sattreṇāpnoti yasmaikaṃ yajño na tad yajñenāpnoti yasmaikaṃ sattraṃ sattram iva vā etad yad anulomaṃ pṛṣṭhāni yadaikadhā pṛṣṭhāni bhavaty ekadhaivāsmiṃs tejo vīryaṃ dadhāty annaṃ pṛṣṭhāny annādyam evāsmin dadhāti paśavaḥ pṛṣṭhāni paśuṣv eva pratitiṣṭhati
22.10.d: अन्यस्मै वै कामाय सत्त्रम् अन्यस्मै यज्ञो न तत् सत्त्रेणाप्नोति यस्मैकं यज्ञो न तद् यज्ञेनाप्नोति यस्मैकं सत्त्रं सत्त्रम् इव वा एतद् यद् अनुलोमं पृष्ठानि यदैकधा पृष्ठानि भवत्य् एकधैवास्मिंस् तेजो वीर्यं दधात्य् अन्नं पृष्ठान्य् अन्नाद्यम् एवास्मिन् दधाति पशवः पृष्ठानि पशुष्व् एव प्रतितिष्ठति
22.10.m: For one desire is a sacrificial session, for another is an ordinary sacrifice. He does not obtain by the sacrificial session that for which an ordinary sacrifice [is meant]; nor does he obtain by an ordinary sacrifice that for which a sacrificial session [is meant]. It is like a sacrificial session, in that the pṛṣṭhas are in natural order. When the pṛṣṭhas are uniform, he places lustre and valour in him in a unified manner. The pṛṣṭhas are food; he places food in him. The pṛṣṭhas are cattle; he is established in cattle.

22.10.s: yad vai manuṣyāṇāṃ pratyakṣaṃ taddevānāṃ parokṣamatha yanma manuṣyāṇāṃ parokṣaṃ taddevānāṃ pratyakṣam
22.10.d: यद् वै मनुष्याणां प्रत्यक्षं तद्देवानां परोक्षमथ यन्म मनुष्याणां परोक्षं तद्देवानां प्रत्यक्षम्
22.10.m: What is visible to men is invisible to the gods; and what is invisible to men is visible to the gods.

22.10.s: etad vai parokṣaṃ vrataṃ yad viśvajit pratyakṣam evaitenānnādyam avarundhe
22.10.d: एतद् वै परोक्षं व्रतं यद् विश्वजित् प्रत्यक्षम् एवैतेनान्नाद्यम् अवरुन्धे
22.10.m: This indeed is the invisible vow, namely the Viśvajit; by this he visibly obtains food.

22.11.m: The pṛṣṭha six-day rite, the Mahāvrata, the Jyotiṣṭoma atirātra.
By this indeed the gods went to divinity.
He who knows this goes to divinity.

22.11.s: etad vai vratam āptaṃ yad aṣṭarātre 'gniṣṭomo hi vrataṃ sampadyate
22.11.d: एतद् वै व्रतम् आप्तं यद् अष्टरात्रे ऽग्निष्टोमो हि व्रतं सम्पद्यते
22.11.m: This vow is attained, that in an eight-day rite the vow becomes an agniṣṭoma.

22.11.s: atha yat jyotiṣṭhomo 'tirātro bhavaty akḷptasya kḷptyai
22.11.d: अथ यत् ज्योतिष्ठोमो ऽतिरात्रो भवत्य् अकॢप्तस्य कॢप्त्यै
22.11.m: Now, that there is the Jyotiṣṭoma atirātra is for the ordering of the disordered.
By the eight-day rite indeed the gods attained all.
He who knows this attains all.

22.12.s: pṛṣṭhayaḥ ṣaḍaho jyotir gaur āyur atirātro devā vai mṛtyor abibhayus te prajāpatim upādhāvaṃs tebhya etena navarātreṇāmṛtatvaṃ prāyacchat
22.12.d: पृष्ठयः षडहो ज्योतिर् गौर् आयुर् अतिरात्रो देवा वै मृत्योर् अबिभयुस् ते प्रजापतिम् उपाधावंस् तेभ्य एतेन नवरात्रेणामृतत्वं प्रायच्छत्
22.12.m: The pṛṣṭha six-day rite, the Jyotis, the Go, the Āyus, the atirātra. The gods indeed were afraid of death; they ran to Prajāpati. To them he granted immortality by this nine-day rite.

22.12.s: etad vāva manuṣyasyāmṛtatvaṃ yat sarvam āyur eti vasīyān bhavati
22.12.d: एतद् वाव मनुष्यस्यामृतत्वं यत् सर्वम् आयुर् एति वसीयान् भवति
22.12.m:
This indeed is immortality for a man: that he reaches a complete lifespan and becomes more prosperous.

He reaches a complete lifespan and becomes more prosperous, who knows this.

22.12.s: sarvam āyur eti vasīyān bhavati ya evaṃ veda
22.12.d: सर्वम् आयुर् एति वसीयान् भवति य एवं वेद

22.12.s: navarātro vā eṣa nava prāṇāḥ prāṇeṣv eva pratitiṣṭhati
22.12.d: नवरात्रो वा एष नव प्राणाः प्राणेष्व् एव प्रतितिष्ठति
22.12.m: This is a nine-day rite; there are nine vital breaths; he is established in the vital breaths.

22.12.s: pṛṣṭhayaḥ ṣaḍaho bhavati pratyakṣam ṛddhayā atha yat jyotir gaur āyur atirātro bhavati pratiṣṭhityai
22.12.d: पृष्ठयः षडहो भवति प्रत्यक्षम् ऋद्धया अथ यत् ज्योतिर् गौर् आयुर् अतिरात्रो भवति प्रतिष्ठित्यै
22.12.m: There is the pṛṣṭha six-day rite, manifestly for prosperity. Then, that there is the Jyotis, Go, Āyus, and atirātra is for firm establishment.

22.13.s: jyotiṣṭomo 'gniṣṭhomo gaur ukthya āyur ukthyo 'bhyāsaṅgyaḥ pañcāho viśvajid atirātraḥ paśukāmo yajeta
22.13.d: ज्योतिष्टोमो ऽग्निष्ठोमो गौर् उक्थ्य आयुर् उक्थ्यो ऽभ्यासङ्ग्यः पञ्चाहो विश्वजिद् अतिरात्रः पशुकामो यजेत
22.13.m: The Jyotiṣṭoma agniṣṭoma, the Go ukthya, the Āyus ukthya, the contiguous five-day rite, the Viśvajit atirātra. One desirous of cattle should sacrifice [with this].

22.13.s: yat jyotir gaur āyus tryahaḥ purastād bhavati prajñātān stomānupaitīmān eva lokān eṣv eva lokeṣu pratitiṣṭhati
22.13.d: यत् ज्योतिर् गौर् आयुस् त्र्यहः पुरस्ताद् भवति प्रज्ञातान् स्तोमानुपैतीमान् एव लोकान् एष्व् एव लोकेषु प्रतितिष्ठति
22.13.m: That the Jyotis, Go, and Āyus three-day rite is in the beginning: he enters upon well-known stomas, these worlds; he is established in these worlds.

22.13.s: atha yad abhyāsaṅgyaḥ pañcāho madhyato bhavati pāṅktaḥ purūṣaḥ pāṅktāḥ paśavas tena purūṣaṃ ca paśūṃś cāpnoti
22.13.d: अथ यद् अभ्यासङ्ग्यः पञ्चाहो मध्यतो भवति पाङ्क्तः पुरूषः पाङ्क्ताः पशवस् तेन पुरूषं च पशूंश् चाप्नोति
22.13.m: Now, that the contiguous five-day rite is in the middle: fivefold is man, fivefold are cattle; thereby he obtains both man and cattle.
The Viśvajit atirātra is for the complete victory over all.

22.14.s: trivṛd agniṣṭomaḥ pañcadaśa ukthyas trivṛd agniṣṭomaḥ saptadaśo 'gniṣṭoma ekaviṃśa ukthyaḥ saptadaśo 'gniṣṭomas triṇavo 'gniṣṭomas trayastriṃśa ukthyas triṇavo 'gniṣṭomo viśvajid atirātraḥ
22.14.d: त्रिवृद् अग्निष्टोमः पञ्चदश उक्थ्यस् त्रिवृद् अग्निष्टोमः सप्तदशो ऽग्निष्टोम एकविंश उक्थ्यः सप्तदशो ऽग्निष्टोमस् त्रिणवो ऽग्निष्टोमस् त्रयस्त्रिंश उक्थ्यस् त्रिणवो ऽग्निष्टोमो विश्वजिद् अतिरात्रः
22.14.m: A ninefold agniṣṭoma, a fifteenfold ukthya, a ninefold agniṣṭoma, a seventeenfold agniṣṭoma, a twenty-one-fold ukthya, a seventeenfold agniṣṭoma, a twenty-seven-fold agniṣṭoma, a thirty-three-fold ukthya, a twenty-seven-fold agniṣṭoma, the Viśvajit atirātra.

22.14.s: indro 'surān hatvākāryaṃ cakṛvāṃ amanyata taṃ devā etena stomenāyājayan sa pāpmano nairdaśyam agacchat
22.14.d: इन्द्रो ऽसुरान् हत्वाकार्यं चकृवां अमन्यत तं देवा एतेन स्तोमेनायाजयन् स पाप्मनो नैर्दश्यम् अगच्छत्
22.14.m: Indra, having slain the Asuras, thought that he had done what ought not to be done. The gods made him sacrifice with this stoma; he went beyond the ten days of evil.

22.14.s: tasmād iṣuhato vā daṇḍahato vā daśamīṃ nairdaśyaṃ gacchati
22.14.d: तस्माद् इषुहतो वा दण्डहतो वा दशमीं नैर्दश्यं गच्छति
22.14.m: Therefore, one struck by an arrow or struck by a stick passes beyond the danger on the tenth day.

22.14.s: daśa daśinī vā eṣā virāḍ annaṃ virāḍ annādyam evāsmin dadhāti
22.14.d: दश दशिनी वा एषा विराड् अन्नं विराड् अन्नाद्यम् एवास्मिन् दधाति
22.14.m: This virāj consists of tens. The virāj is food; he places food in him.

22.14.s: agniṣṭomena vai devā asurān nigṛhya madhyata ukthaiḥ prajayā paśubhiḥ prājāyantāgniṣṭomenaiva bhrātṛvyaṃ nigṛhya madhyata ukthyaiḥ prajayā paśubhiḥ prajāyate
22.14.d: अग्निष्टोमेन वै देवा असुरान् निगृह्य मध्यत उक्थैः प्रजया पशुभिः प्राजायन्ताग्निष्टोमेनैव भ्रातृव्यं निगृह्य मध्यत उक्थ्यैः प्रजया पशुभिः प्रजायते
22.14.m: The gods indeed, having restrained the Asuras with the agniṣṭoma, propagated in the middle with offspring and cattle through the ukthyas. Having restrained the rival with the agniṣṭoma, he propagates in the middle with offspring and cattle through the ukthyas.

22.14.s: trikakup samānānāṃ ca prajānāṃ ca bhavati ya evaṃ veda
22.14.d: त्रिककुप् समानानां च प्रजानां च भवति य एवं वेद
22.14.m: He who knows this becomes three-peaked among his equals and among his offspring.

22.15.s: trayastrivṛto 'gniṣṭomās trayaḥ pañcadaśa ukthyās trayaḥ saptadaśa ukthyā ekaviṃśo 'tirātraḥ kusuruvindadaśarātraḥ
22.15.d: त्रयस्त्रिवृतो ऽग्निष्टोमास् त्रयः पञ्चदश उक्थ्यास् त्रयः सप्तदश उक्थ्या एकविंशो ऽतिरात्रः कुसुरुविन्ददशरात्रः
22.15.m: Three ninefold agniṣṭomas, three fifteenfold ukthyas, three seventeenfold ukthyas, a twenty-one-fold atirātra: [this is] the Kusurubinda ten-day rite.

22.15.s: yaḥ kāmayeta bahu syām iti sa etena yajeta
22.15.d: यः कामयेत बहु स्याम् इति स एतेन यजेत
22.15.m: Whoever should desire, 'May I become manifold,' should sacrifice with this.

22.15.s: yad gaṇaśaḥ stomo bahur eva bhavati
22.15.d: यद् गणशः स्तोमो बहुर् एव भवति
22.15.m: In that the stoma is in groups, he becomes manifold.

22.15.s: saha trivṛta saha pañcadaśāḥ saha saptadaśāḥ
22.15.d: सह त्रिवृत सह पञ्चदशाः सह सप्तदशाः
22.15.m: Together are the ninefold stomas, together the fifteenfold stomas, together the seventeenfold stomas.
There is a twenty-one-fold atirātra, for firm establishment.

22.15.s: jyotiṣ prajānāṃ bhavati ya evaṃ veda
22.15.d: ज्योतिष् प्रजानां भवति य एवं वेद
22.15.m: He becomes a light of creatures who knows thus.

22.15.s: catuṣṭomo vā eṣa catuṣpādāḥ paśavaḥ paśuṣv eva pratitiṣṭhati
22.15.d: चतुष्टोमो वा एष चतुष्पादाः पशवः पशुष्व् एव प्रतितिष्ठति
22.15.m: This is a four-stoma rite; cattle are four-footed; he establishes himself firmly in cattle.

22.15.s: ekaviṃśaṃ stomā nātiyanti pratiṣṭhā vā ekaviṃśaḥ praty eva tiṣṭhati
22.15.d: एकविंशं स्तोमा नातियन्ति प्रतिष्ठा वा एकविंशः प्रत्य् एव तिष्ठति
22.15.m: The stomas do not exceed the twenty-one-fold stoma; the twenty-one-fold stoma is a firm foundation; he establishes himself firmly.

22.15.s: etena vai kusurūvinda auddālakir iṣṭvā bhūmānam āśnuta
22.15.d: एतेन वै कुसुरूविन्द औद्दालकिर् इष्ट्वा भूमानम् आश्नुत
22.15.m: By this Kusurūvinda Auddālaki, having sacrificed, attained abundance.
He attains abundance who knows thus.

22.16.s: abhyāsaṅgyaḥ pañcāhaś catvāraś chandomaḥ viśvajid atirātraḥ paśukāmo yajeta
22.16.d: अभ्यासङ्ग्यः पञ्चाहश् चत्वारश् छन्दोमः विश्वजिद् अतिरात्रः पशुकामो यजेत
22.16.m: The five-day rite with repeated [stomas], four Chandomas, [and] the Viśvajit atirātra: one desiring cattle should sacrifice [with this].

22.16.s: yad abhyāsaṅgyaḥ pañcāhaḥ purastād bhavati pāṅktaḥ puruṣaḥ pāṅktāḥ paśavas tena purūṣaṃ ca paśūṃś cāpnoti
22.16.d: यद् अभ्यासङ्ग्यः पञ्चाहः पुरस्ताद् भवति पाङ्क्तः पुरुषः पाङ्क्ताः पशवस् तेन पुरूषं च पशूंश् चाप्नोति
22.16.m: Since the five-day rite with repeated [stomas] comes first: man is fivefold, cattle are fivefold; thereby he obtains both man and cattle.

22.16.s: chandomā madhyato bhavanti paśavo vai chandomāḥ paśūnām avarudhyai
22.16.d: छन्दोमा मध्यतो भवन्ति पशवो वै छन्दोमाः पशूनाम् अवरुध्यै
22.16.m: The Chandomas are in the middle; the Chandomas are cattle, for the secure acquisition of cattle.
The Viśvajit is an atirātra, for the winning of all.

22.17.s: triṣṭomo 'gniṣṭomo jyotir ukthyas triṣṭomo 'gniṣṭomo gaurukthyo 'bhijid agniṣṭomo gaur ukthyo viśvajid agniṣṭoma āyur ukthyo viśvajid agniṣṭomasya sarvastomo 'tirātraḥ
22.17.d: त्रिष्टोमो ऽग्निष्टोमो ज्योतिर् उक्थ्यस् त्रिष्टोमो ऽग्निष्टोमो गौरुक्थ्यो ऽभिजिद् अग्निष्टोमो गौर् उक्थ्यो विश्वजिद् अग्निष्टोम आयुर् उक्थ्यो विश्वजिद् अग्निष्टोमस्य सर्वस्तोमो ऽतिरात्रः
22.17.m: A three-stoma agniṣṭoma, a Jyotis ukthya, a three-stoma agniṣṭoma, a Go ukthya, an Abhijit agniṣṭoma, a Go ukthya, a Viśvajit agniṣṭoma, an Āyus ukthya, [and] of the Viśvajit agniṣṭoma an all-stoma atirātra.

22.17.s: devā vā asurair hanyamānās te prajāpatim upādhāvaṃs tebhya etāṃ devapuraṃ prāyacchat tāṃ prāviśan
22.17.d: देवा वा असुरैर् हन्यमानास् ते प्रजापतिम् उपाधावंस् तेभ्य एतां देवपुरं प्रायच्छत् तां प्राविशन्
22.17.m: The gods, being slain by the asuras, ran to Prajāpati; he gave them this fortress of the gods; they entered it.

22.17.s: abhicāryamāṇaṃ yājayed etām eva devapuraṃ praviśaty asṛtyai
22.17.d: अभिचार्यमाणं याजयेद् एताम् एव देवपुरं प्रविशत्य् असृत्यै
22.17.m: One should make him on whom malevolent magic is practised sacrifice [with this]; he enters this very fortress of the gods, for non-destruction.

22.18.s: abhyāsaṅgyaḥ ṣaḍahas trayaś chandomāś catuṣṭomo 'gniṣṭomo viśvajid atirātraḥ
22.18.d: अभ्यासङ्ग्यः षडहस् त्रयश् छन्दोमाश् चतुष्टोमो ऽग्निष्टोमो विश्वजिद् अतिरात्रः
22.18.m: The six-day rite with repeated [stomas], three Chandomas, a four-stoma agniṣṭoma, [and] the Viśvajit atirātra.
He goes to sovereign rule who knows thus.
For Prajāpati is sovereign rule; Parameṣṭhin is sovereign rule.
He attains the state of Parameṣṭhin who knows thus.

22.18.s: ubhe bṛhadrathantare bhavatas tad dhi svārājyam ayutaṃ dakṣiṇās tad dhi svārājyaṃ ṣaḍviṃśastomo bhavati sa hi svārājyaṃ catuṣṭomastomaḥ sa hy anto 'nte śriyā gacchati ya evaṃ veda
22.18.d: उभे बृहद्रथन्तरे भवतस् तद् धि स्वाराज्यम् अयुतं दक्षिणास् तद् धि स्वाराज्यं षड्विंशस्तोमो भवति स हि स्वाराज्यं चतुष्टोमस्तोमः स ह्य् अन्तो ऽन्ते श्रिया गच्छति य एवं वेद
22.18.m: Both Bṛhat and Rathantara are present, for that is sovereign rule; ten thousand are the sacrificial gifts, for that is sovereign rule; it has the twenty-six-fold stoma, for that is sovereign rule; its stoma is the four-stoma, for that is the end; he reaches the end with glory who knows thus.

22.18.s: etena vai kṣema dhṛtvā pauṇḍarīkaṃ iṣṭvā sudāmnas tīra uttare
22.18.d: एतेन वै क्षेम धृत्वा पौण्डरीकं इष्ट्वा सुदाम्नस् तीर उत्तरे
22.18.m: By this Kṣema Dhṛtva Pauṇḍarīka, having sacrificed on the northern bank of the Sudāman,

22.18.s: sarvām ṛddhim ārdhnot sarvāmṛddhim ṛdhnoti ya evaṃ veda
22.18.d: सर्वाम् ऋद्धिम् आर्ध्नोत् सर्वामृद्धिम् ऋध्नोति य एवं वेद
22.18.m: prospered in all prosperity; he prospers in all prosperity who knows thus.

23.1.s: atirātraḥ pṛṣṭhayaḥ ṣaḍahaḥ sarvastomo 'tirātraś catvāraś chandomā atirātraḥ
23.1.d: अतिरात्रः पृष्ठयः षडहः सर्वस्तोमो ऽतिरात्रश् चत्वारश् छन्दोमा अतिरात्रः
23.1.m: An atirātra, a pṛṣṭhya six-day rite, an all-stoma atirātra, four Chandomas, [and] an atirātra.

23.1.s: eṣa vā āpto dvādaśāho yat trayodaśarātraḥ
23.1.d: एष वा आप्तो द्वादशाहो यत् त्रयोदशरात्रः
23.1.m: This is the complete twelve-day rite, which is the thirteen-day rite.

23.1.s: samāno hy eṣa yat prayaṇīyaś codayanīyaś cātirātrau kāmaṃ kāmayante tam etābhir abhyaśnuvate
23.1.d: समानो ह्य् एष यत् प्रयणीयश् चोदयनीयश् चातिरात्रौ कामं कामयन्ते तम् एताभिर् अभ्यश्नुवते
23.1.m: For it is identical in that the opening and concluding rites are atirātras; whatever desire they desire, that they obtain by these [nights].

23.1.s: gṛhapates tu vāg upadāsukā bhavati tad yan madhye sarvastomo 'tirātro bhavati tena gṛhapater vāg anupadāsukā bhavati
23.1.d: गृहपतेस् तु वाग् उपदासुका भवति तद् यन् मध्ये सर्वस्तोमो ऽतिरात्रो भवति तेन गृहपतेर् वाग् अनुपदासुका भवति
23.1.m: The voice of the householder is liable to fail; that an all-stoma atirātra is in the middle, thereby the voice of the householder does not fail.

23.1.s: etā vā aryalagṛhapataya ārūṇihotāraḥ subhagāsūpayanti te sarvām ṛddhim ārdhnuvan sarvām ṛddhim ṛdhnuvanti ya etā upayanti
23.1.d: एता वा अर्यलगृहपतय आरूणिहोतारः सुभगासूपयन्ति ते सर्वाम् ऋद्धिम् आर्ध्नुवन् सर्वाम् ऋद्धिम् ऋध्नुवन्ति य एता उपयन्ति
23.1.m: These [nights] the Aryalas as householders, the Āruṇis as hotṛs, fortunate, undertook; they prospered in all prosperity; they prosper in all prosperity who undertake these [nights].

23.2.s: atirātro dvādaśāhasya daśāhāni mahāvrataṃ cātirātraś ca
23.2.d: अतिरात्रो द्वादशाहस्य दशाहानि महाव्रतं चातिरात्रश् च
23.2.m: An atirātra, the ten days of the twelve-day rite, the Mahāvrata, and an atirātra.

23.2.s: vāg vā eṣā pratāyate yad eṣa dvādaśāhas tāṃ vicchindyur yan madhye 'tirātraṃ kuryuḥ
23.2.d: वाग् वा एषा प्रतायते यद् एष द्वादशाहस् तां विच्छिन्द्युर् यन् मध्ये ऽतिरात्रं कुर्युः
23.2.m: Speech is extended here, which is this twelve-day rite; they would cut it asunder if they were to place an atirātra in the middle.

23.2.s: yad upariṣṭād vratam upayanti na vācaṃ vicchindanty āpnuvanti trayodaśaṃ māsam
23.2.d: यद् उपरिष्टाद् व्रतम् उपयन्ति न वाचं विच्छिन्दन्त्य् आप्नुवन्ति त्रयोदशं मासम्
23.2.m: Since they undertake the vow at the end, they do not cut speech asunder; they obtain the thirteenth month.

23.2.s: etā vai pratiṣṭhitās trayodaśa rātrayaḥ pratitiṣṭhanti ya etā upayanti
23.2.d: एता वै प्रतिष्ठितास् त्रयोदश रात्रयः प्रतितिष्ठन्ति य एता उपयन्ति
23.2.m: These are firmly established thirteen nights; they establish themselves firmly who undertake these [nights].

23.3.s: atirātraḥ pṛṣṭhayaḥ ṣaḍahaḥ pṛṣṭhayaḥ ṣaḍahas trayastriṃśārambhaṇo 'tirātraḥ
23.3.d: अतिरात्रः पृष्ठयः षडहः पृष्ठयः षडहस् त्रयस्त्रिंशारम्भणो ऽतिरात्रः
23.3.m: An atirātra, a pṛṣṭhya six-day rite, a pṛṣṭhya six-day rite, [and] an atirātra beginning with the thirty-three-fold stoma.
These nights are obtainers of desires.

23.3.s: virāḍh ḍhi daśātmaikādaśī prajā dvādaśī paśavas trayodaśī kāmāya caturdaśī
23.3.d: विराढ् ढि दशात्मैकादशी प्रजा द्वादशी पशवस् त्रयोदशी कामाय चतुर्दशी
23.3.m: For the virāj is ten; the self is the eleventh; offspring is the twelfth; cattle is the thirteenth; the fourteenth is for desire.
All desires they secure by these [nights].

23.3.s: etā vāva bradhnasya viṣṭapo yad etau trayastriṃśau madhyataḥ saṃdhīyete tena bradhnasya viṣṭapaṃ rohanti
23.3.d: एता वाव ब्रध्नस्य विष्टपो यद् एतौ त्रयस्त्रिंशौ मध्यतः संधीयेते तेन ब्रध्नस्य विष्टपं रोहन्ति
23.3.m: These indeed are the surface of the ruddy sun: that these two thirty-three-fold [days] are joined in the middle, thereby they ascend to the surface of the ruddy sun.

23.3.s: dviḥ pṛṣṭhāny upayanty abhipūrvam evaitābhir annādyaṃ dadhate
23.3.d: द्विः पृष्ठान्य् उपयन्त्य् अभिपूर्वम् एवैताभिर् अन्नाद्यं दधते
23.3.m: Twice they undertake the pṛṣṭhas; in regular order they secure food for themselves by these [nights].

23.4.s: atirātro jyotir gaur āyus tryahaḥ pṛṣṭhya ṣaḍaha āyur gaur jyotir atirātraḥ
23.4.d: अतिरात्रो ज्योतिर् गौर् आयुस् त्र्यहः पृष्ठ्य षडह आयुर् गौर् ज्योतिर् अतिरात्रः
23.4.m: An atirātra, the three-day rite consisting of Jyotis, Go, [and] Āyus, a pṛṣṭhya six-day rite, Āyus, Go, Jyotis, [and] an atirātra.

23.4.s: yāṃs talpe vodake vā vivāhe vā mīmāṃseraṃs ta etā upeyuḥ
23.4.d: यांस् तल्पे वोदके वा विवाहे वा मीमांसेरंस् त एता उपेयुः
23.4.m: Those whose eligibility for the marriage bed, or for water, or for marriage they would call into question, they should undertake these [nights].

23.4.s: yat jyotir gaur āyus tryahaḥ prajñātāṃ stomān upayanti
23.4.d: यत् ज्योतिर् गौर् आयुस् त्र्यहः प्रज्ञातां स्तोमान् उपयन्ति
23.4.m: In that there is the three-day rite of Jyotis, Go, [and] Āyus, they undertake well-known stomas.

23.4.s: imān eva lokān eṣv eva lokeṣu pratitiṣṭhānti
23.4.d: इमान् एव लोकान् एष्व् एव लोकेषु प्रतितिष्ठान्ति
23.4.m: These worlds indeed: in these very worlds they establish themselves firmly.

23.4.s: atha yat pṛṣṭhayaḥ ṣaḍaho madhyato bhavaty eṣu vāva devatalpo devatalpam eva tad ārohanti talpyā bhavanti
23.4.d: अथ यत् पृष्ठयः षडहो मध्यतो भवत्य् एषु वाव देवतल्पो देवतल्पम् एव तद् आरोहन्ति तल्प्या भवन्ति
23.4.m: Then, in that the pṛṣṭhya six-day rite is in the middle: among these is the bed of the gods; it is the bed of the gods that they then ascend; they become worthy of the bed.
They attain the bed of one who is more prosperous.

23.4.s: atha yad āyur gaur jyotir atirātro yeneto yanti tena punar āyanti
23.4.d: अथ यद् आयुर् गौर् ज्योतिर् अतिरात्रो येनेतो यन्ति तेन पुनर् आयन्ति
23.4.m: Then, in that there is Āyus, Go, Jyotis, [and] an atirātra: by that [path] by which they go thither, by that they return.

23.5.s: atirātro gauś cāyuś ca dve ahanī dvādaśāhasya daśāhāny atirātraḥ
23.5.d: अतिरात्रो गौश् चायुश् च द्वे अहनी द्वादशाहस्य दशाहान्य् अतिरात्रः
23.5.m: An atirātra, Go and Āyus as two days, the ten days of the twelve-day rite, [and] an atirātra.

23.5.s: yad gauś cāyuś ca dve ahanī bhavato mithunau stomāv upayanti prajātyai
23.5.d: यद् गौश् चायुश् च द्वे अहनी भवतो मिथुनौ स्तोमाव् उपयन्ति प्रजात्यै
23.5.m: In that Go and Āyus are two days, they undertake two stomas as a pair, for propagation.

23.5.s: atha yāni dvādaśāhasya daśāhāni vācam avicchinnām upayanti prajananāya
23.5.d: अथ यानि द्वादशाहस्य दशाहानि वाचम् अविच्छिन्नाम् उपयन्ति प्रजननाय
23.5.m: Then, as for the ten days of the twelve-day rite: they undertake unbroken speech, for generation.

23.5.s: etā vai pratiṣṭhitāś caturdaśa rātrayaḥ pratitiṣṭhanti ya etā upayanti
23.5.d: एता वै प्रतिष्ठिताश् चतुर्दश रात्रयः प्रतितिष्ठन्ति य एता उपयन्ति
23.5.m: These are firmly established fourteen nights; they establish themselves firmly who undertake these [nights].

23.6.s: atirātraḥ pṛṣṭhayaḥ ṣaḍaho mahāvrataṃ pṛṣṭhayaḥ ṣaḍahas trayastriṃśārambhaṇo 'tirātraḥ
23.6.d: अतिरात्रः पृष्ठयः षडहो महाव्रतं पृष्ठयः षडहस् त्रयस्त्रिंशारम्भणो ऽतिरात्रः
23.6.m: An atirātra, a pṛṣṭhya six-day rite, the Mahāvrata, a pṛṣṭhya six-day rite, [and] an atirātra beginning with the thirty-three-fold stoma.

23.6.s: etābhir vai devā devatvam agacchan devatvaṃ gacchanti ya etā upayanti
23.6.d: एताभिर् वै देवा देवत्वम् अगच्छन् देवत्वं गच्छन्ति य एता उपयन्ति
23.6.m: By these [nights] the gods went to divinity; they go to divinity who undertake these [nights].

23.6.s: etad vai devānāṃ sattraṃ tad adyāpi devāḥ sattram āsate
23.6.d: एतद् वै देवानां सत्त्रं तद् अद्यापि देवाः सत्त्रम् आसते
23.6.m: This is the sacrificial session of the gods; even today the gods sit at this sacrificial session.

23.6.s: paurṇamāsy atirātro 'tha yāni ṣaḍ ahāni sa pṛṣṭhayaḥ ṣaḍaha ekāṣṭakā mahāvratam atha yāni ṣaḍ ahāni sa pṛṣṭhayaḥ ṣaḍaho 'māvāsyātirātraḥ
23.6.d: पौर्णमास्य् अतिरात्रो ऽथ यानि षड् अहानि स पृष्ठयः षडह एकाष्टका महाव्रतम् अथ यानि षड् अहानि स पृष्ठयः षडहो ऽमावास्यातिरात्रः
23.6.m: The full-moon day is an atirātra; then the six days that follow are the pṛṣṭhya six-day rite; the Ekāṣṭakā is the Mahāvrata; then the six days that follow are the pṛṣṭhya six-day rite; the new-moon day is an atirātra.

23.6.s: tasmāt tarhi manuṣyāṇāṃ na suto devānāṃ hi tarhi sutaḥ pratyakṣam evaitābhir devatā abhyārohanti
23.6.d: तस्मात् तर्हि मनुष्याणां न सुतो देवानां हि तर्हि सुतः प्रत्यक्षम् एवैताभिर् देवता अभ्यारोहन्ति
23.6.m: Therefore at that time there is no Soma-pressing for men, for at that time the Soma-pressing is of the gods; directly by these [nights] they ascend to the deities.

23.6.s: pratinodāt tu bhayyam itaram anupakṣo dīkṣerann apratinodāya
23.6.d: प्रतिनोदात् तु भय्यम् इतरम् अनुपक्षो दीक्षेरन्न् अप्रतिनोदाय
23.6.m: From mutual conflict, however, fear is to be expected; they should consecrate themselves without rivalry, to avoid mutual conflict.

23.7.s: atirātras trivṛd agniṣṭud agniṣṭomo jyotir gaur āyus tryahaḥ pṛṣṭhayaḥ ṣaḍaha āyur gaur jyotir atirātraḥ
23.7.d: अतिरात्रस् त्रिवृद् अग्निष्टुद् अग्निष्टोमो ज्योतिर् गौर् आयुस् त्र्यहः पृष्ठयः षडह आयुर् गौर् ज्योतिर् अतिरात्रः
23.7.m: An atirātra, a ninefold Agniṣṭut agniṣṭoma, the three-day rite consisting of Jyotis, Go, [and] Āyus, a pṛṣṭhya six-day rite, Āyus, Go, Jyotis, [and] an atirātra.
Those desiring brahminical lustre should undertake [them].

23.7.s: yat trivṛd agniṣṭud agniṣṭomo bhavati brahma tad yaśasārdhayati
23.7.d: यत् त्रिवृद् अग्निष्टुद् अग्निष्टोमो भवति ब्रह्म तद् यशसार्धयति
23.7.m: In that there is a ninefold Agniṣṭut agniṣṭoma, thereby he causes the priesthood to prosper with glory.

23.7.s: yat jyotir gaur āyus tryahaḥ prajñātān stomān upayantīmān eva lokān eṣv eva lokeṣu pratitiṣṭhanty atha yat pṛṣṭhayaḥ ṣaḍaho madhyato bhavaty annaṃ vai pṛṣṭāny annam eva tan madhyato dhīyate tasmān madhye sad annaṃ dhinoty atha yad āyur gaur jyotir atirātro yeneto yanti tena punar āyanti
23.7.d: यत् ज्योतिर् गौर् आयुस् त्र्यहः प्रज्ञातान् स्तोमान् उपयन्तीमान् एव लोकान् एष्व् एव लोकेषु प्रतितिष्ठन्त्य् अथ यत् पृष्ठयः षडहो मध्यतो भवत्य् अन्नं वै पृष्टान्य् अन्नम् एव तन् मध्यतो धीयते तस्मान् मध्ये सद् अन्नं धिनोत्य् अथ यद् आयुर् गौर् ज्योतिर् अतिरात्रो येनेतो यन्ति तेन पुनर् आयन्ति
23.7.m: In that there is the three-day rite of Jyotis, Go, [and] Āyus, they undertake well-known stomas, these very worlds; in these very worlds they establish themselves firmly. Then, in that the pṛṣṭhya six-day rite is in the middle: the pṛṣṭhas are food; it is food that is then placed in the middle; therefore, being in the middle, food satisfies. Then, in that there is Āyus, Go, Jyotis, [and] an atirātra: by that [path] by which they go thither, by that they return.

23.8.s: trivṛd agniṣṭud agniṣṭomo jyotir gaur āyus tryaho dvādaśāhasya daśāhāny atirātraḥ
23.8.d: त्रिवृद् अग्निष्टुद् अग्निष्टोमो ज्योतिर् गौर् आयुस् त्र्यहो द्वादशाहस्य दशाहान्य् अतिरात्रः
23.8.m: A ninefold Agniṣṭut agniṣṭoma, the three-day rite consisting of Jyotis, Go, [and] Āyus, the ten days of the twelve-day rite, [and] an atirātra.

23.8.s: anyasmai vai kāmāya sattram anyasmai yajño na tat sattreṇāpnoti yasmaikaṃ yajño na tad yajñenāpnoti yasmaikaṃ sattram
23.8.d: अन्यस्मै वै कामाय सत्त्रम् अन्यस्मै यज्ञो न तत् सत्त्रेणाप्नोति यस्मैकं यज्ञो न तद् यज्ञेनाप्नोति यस्मैकं सत्त्रम्
23.8.m: For one desire is a sacrificial session, for another is a sacrifice; one does not attain by a sacrificial session that for which a sacrifice is [performed], nor does one attain by a sacrifice that for which a sacrificial session is [performed].

23.8.s: yad anyato 'tirātrās tena yajño 'tha yāni dvādaśāhasya daśāhāni tena sattram
23.8.d: यद् अन्यतो ऽतिरात्रास् तेन यज्ञो ऽथ यानि द्वादशाहस्य दशाहानि तेन सत्त्रम्
23.8.m: In that there are atirātras on both sides, by that it is a sacrifice; and those which are the ten days of the twelve-day rite, by that it is a sacrificial session.
They obtain both desires by these [nights].

23.9.s: atirātro jyotir gaur āyus tryaho dvādaśāhasya daśāhāny atirātraḥ prajākāmā upeyuḥ
23.9.d: अतिरात्रो ज्योतिर् गौर् आयुस् त्र्यहो द्वादशाहस्य दशाहान्य् अतिरात्रः प्रजाकामा उपेयुः
23.9.m: An atirātra, the three-day period of Jyotis, Go, and Āyus, the ten days of the twelve-day rite, and an atirātra: those desirous of offspring should undertake [this rite].

23.9.s: etābhir vai prajāpatiḥ prajā asṛjata pra prajayā pra paśubhir jāyante ya etā upayanti
23.9.d: एताभिर् वै प्रजापतिः प्रजा असृजत प्र प्रजया प्र पशुभिर् जायन्ते य एता उपयन्ति
23.9.m: By these, indeed, Prajāpati created offspring; they propagate with offspring and with cattle who undertake these [nights].

23.9.s: yat jyotir gaur āyus tryahaḥ prajātān stomān upayantīmān eva lokān eṣv eva lokeṣu pratitiṣṭhanti
23.9.d: यत् ज्योतिर् गौर् आयुस् त्र्यहः प्रजातान् स्तोमान् उपयन्तीमान् एव लोकान् एष्व् एव लोकेषु प्रतितिष्ठन्ति
23.9.m: In that there is the three-day period of Jyotis, Go, and Āyus, they undertake the produced stomas, these very worlds; in these very worlds they become established.

23.9.s: atha yāni dvādaśāhasya daśāhāni vācam avicchinnām upayanti prajananāya
23.9.d: अथ यानि द्वादशाहस्य दशाहानि वाचम् अविच्छिन्नाम् उपयन्ति प्रजननाय
23.9.m: And those which are the ten days of the twelve-day rite, they undertake unbroken speech for procreation.

23.9.s: etā vai pratiṣṭhitāḥ pañcadaśa rātrayaḥ pratitiṣṭhanti ya etā upayanti
23.9.d: एता वै प्रतिष्ठिताः पञ्चदश रात्रयः प्रतितिष्ठन्ति य एता उपयन्ति
23.9.m: These fifteen nights are indeed firmly established; they become firmly established who undertake these [nights].

23.10.s: etābhir vā indraḥ paramāṃ vijitiṃ vyajayata paramām evaitābhir vijitiṃ vijayante
23.10.d: एताभिर् वा इन्द्रः परमां विजितिं व्यजयत परमाम् एवैताभिर् विजितिं विजयन्ते
23.10.m: By these, indeed, Indra won the supreme victory; by these they win the supreme victory.

23.10.s: pañcadaśo vai vajro na vā agṛhītena vajreṇa vīryaṃ karoti yā ṣoḍaśy ārambhaṇam eva tad gṛhītena vajreṇa vīryaṃ karoti
23.10.d: पञ्चदशो वै वज्रो न वा अगृहीतेन वज्रेण वीर्यं करोति या षोडश्य् आरम्भणम् एव तद् गृहीतेन वज्रेण वीर्यं करोति
23.10.m: The fifteenfold stoma is indeed the thunderbolt; one does not perform heroic deeds with an ungrasped thunderbolt; that which is the sixteenth [day] is its handle; with a grasped thunderbolt one performs heroic deeds.

23.11.s: atirātro jyotir gaur āyur gaur āyuḥ pañcāho dvādaśāhasya daśāhāny atirātraḥ
23.11.d: अतिरात्रो ज्योतिर् गौर् आयुर् गौर् आयुः पञ्चाहो द्वादशाहस्य दशाहान्य् अतिरात्रः
23.11.m: An atirātra, the five-day period of Jyotis, Go, Āyus, Go, and Āyus, the ten days of the twelve-day rite, and an atirātra.

23.11.s: etābhir vai prajāpatir anantāṃ śriyam ajayad anantā vā etā yat pañcāhavidhāḥ
23.11.d: एताभिर् वै प्रजापतिर् अनन्तां श्रियम् अजयद् अनन्ता वा एता यत् पञ्चाहविधाः
23.11.m: By these, indeed, Prajāpati won endless prosperity; these are indeed endless, in that they consist of five-day periods.
In that there is a five-day period, they are born from the endless itself.

23.11.s: atha yāni dvādaśāhasya daśāhāni vācam avicchinnām upayanti prajananāya
23.11.d: अथ यानि द्वादशाहस्य दशाहानि वाचम् अविच्छिन्नाम् उपयन्ति प्रजननाय
23.11.m: And those which are the ten days of the twelve-day rite, they undertake unbroken speech for procreation.

23.11.s: etā vai pratiṣṭhitāḥ saptadaśa rātrayaḥ pratitiṣṭhanti ya etā upayanti
23.11.d: एता वै प्रतिष्ठिताः सप्तदश रात्रयः प्रतितिष्ठन्ति य एता उपयन्ति
23.11.m: These seventeen nights are indeed firmly established; they become firmly established who undertake these [nights].

23.12.d: अतिरात्रो ऽभिप्लवः षडहो द्वादशाहस्य दशाहान्य् अतिरात्रः
23.12.m: An atirātra, the six-day Abhiplava, the ten days of the twelve-day rite, and an atirātra.

23.12.s: devā vai mṛtyor abibhayus te prajāpatim upādhāvaṃs tebhya etenāṣṭādaśarātreṇāmṛtatvaṃ prāyacchat
23.12.d: देवा वै मृत्योर् अबिभयुस् ते प्रजापतिम् उपाधावंस् तेभ्य एतेनाष्टादशरात्रेणामृतत्वं प्रायच्छत्
23.12.m: The gods were afraid of death; they ran to Prajāpati; to them, through this eighteen-night [rite], he gave immortality.

23.12.s: etad vāva manuṣyasyāmṛtatvaṃ yat sarvam āyur eti vasīyān bhavati
23.12.d: एतद् वाव मनुष्यस्यामृतत्वं यत् सर्वम् आयुर् एति वसीयान् भवति
23.12.m: This is indeed man's immortality: that he reaches his full lifespan and becomes wealthier.

23.12.s: sarvam āyur yanti vasīyāṃso bhavanti ya etā upayanti
23.12.d: सर्वम् आयुर् यन्ति वसीयांसो भवन्ति य एता उपयन्ति
23.12.m: They reach their full lifespan and become wealthier who undertake these [nights].

23.12.s: dvir vā etā nava nava prāṇā abhipūrvam evaitābhir āyur dadhate
23.12.d: द्विर् वा एता नव नव प्राणा अभिपूर्वम् एवैताभिर् आयुर् दधते
23.12.m: Twice nine are these [days]; nine are the vital breaths; through these they obtain life in proper succession.

23.13.s: etābhir vai vāyur āraṇyānāṃ paśunām ādhipatyaṃ gacchanti ya etā upayanti
23.13.d: एताभिर् वै वायुर् आरण्यानां पशुनाम् आधिपत्यं गच्छन्ति य एता उपयन्ति
23.13.m: By these, indeed, Vāyu [attained] lordship of wild animals; they attain [lordship] who undertake these [nights].

23.13.s: etābhir vā āraṇyāḥ paśavo nākṛtāḥ prajāyante
23.13.d: एताभिर् वा आरण्याः पशवो नाकृताः प्रजायन्ते
23.13.m: By these, indeed, wild animals propagate without a mark.

23.13.s: anākṛtam eṣāṃ prajāyate ya etā upayanti
23.13.d: अनाकृतम् एषां प्रजायते य एता उपयन्ति
23.13.m: Without a mark their [offspring] is born who undertake these [nights].

23.14.s: atrirātro 'bhiplavaḥ ṣaḍaho 'bhijic ca viśvajic ca dve ahanī dvādaśāhasya daśāhāny atirātraḥ
23.14.d: अत्रिरात्रो ऽभिप्लवः षडहो ऽभिजिच् च विश्वजिच् च द्वे अहनी द्वादशाहस्य दशाहान्य् अतिरात्रः
23.14.m: An atirātra, the six-day Abhiplava, Abhijit and Viśvajit as two days, the ten days of the twelve-day rite, and an atirātra.

23.14.s: purūṣakāmā upeyur etābhir vai prajāpatiḥ purūṣam asṛjata
23.14.d: पुरूषकामा उपेयुर् एताभिर् वै प्रजापतिः पुरूषम् असृजत
23.14.m: Those desirous of men should undertake [this rite]; by these, indeed, Prajāpati created man.

23.14.s: sa sarvasyānnādyasyādhipatyam agacchat sarvasyānnādyasyādhipatyaṃ gacchanti ya etā upayanti
23.14.d: स सर्वस्यान्नाद्यस्याधिपत्यम् अगच्छत् सर्वस्यान्नाद्यस्याधिपत्यं गच्छन्ति य एता उपयन्ति
23.14.m: He attained lordship over all food; they attain lordship over all food who undertake these [nights].

23.14.s: viṃśo vai purūṣo daśa hi hastyā aṅgulyo daśa pādyāḥ
23.14.d: विंशो वै पुरूषो दश हि हस्त्या अङ्गुल्यो दश पाद्याः
23.14.m: Man consists of twenty parts: ten are the fingers of the hand, ten are the toes.

23.14.s: yad etā viṃśatī rātrayo bhavanty eṣv evaitābhir lokeṣu purūṣaṃ pratiṣṭhāpayanti
23.14.d: यद् एता विंशती रात्रयो भवन्त्य् एष्व् एवैताभिर् लोकेषु पुरूषं प्रतिष्ठापयन्ति
23.14.m: In that there are these twenty nights, by these they establish man in these worlds.

23.14.s: etā vai pratiṣṭhitā viṃśatī rātrayaḥ pratitiṣṭhanti ya etā upayanti
23.14.d: एता वै प्रतिष्ठिता विंशती रात्रयः प्रतितिष्ठन्ति य एता उपयन्ति
23.14.m: These twenty nights are indeed firmly established; they become firmly established who undertake these [nights].

23.15.s: atirātro 'bhiplavaḥ ṣaḍaho 'tirātro 'bhiplavaḥ ṣaḍaho 'bhiplavaḥ ṣaḍaho 'tirātraḥ paśukāmā upeyuḥ
23.15.d: अतिरात्रो ऽभिप्लवः षडहो ऽतिरात्रो ऽभिप्लवः षडहो ऽभिप्लवः षडहो ऽतिरात्रः पशुकामा उपेयुः
23.15.m: An atirātra, a six-day Abhiplava, an atirātra, a six-day Abhiplava, a six-day Abhiplava, and an atirātra: those desirous of cattle should undertake [this rite].

23.15.s: etābhir vā ādityāḥ sapta grāmyān paśūn udasṛjanta paśūn evaitābhir utsṛjanti
23.15.d: एताभिर् वा आदित्याः सप्त ग्राम्यान् पशून् उदसृजन्त पशून् एवैताभिर् उत्सृजन्ति
23.15.m: By these, indeed, the Ādityas brought forth the seven domestic cattle; by these they bring forth cattle.
Three times seven are the Ādityas, seven by seven.
